title.en: Starmer unveils extra £15bn for UK armed forces but says defence spending cannot be ‘bottomless pit’ – UK politics live
title.zh: 斯塔默公布为英国武装部队额外拨款150亿英镑，但表示国防开支不能是‘无底洞’——英国政治直播

summary.en: Labour leader Keir Starmer announced an additional £15 billion for the UK armed forces, stating that some capital projects in roads and energy have been postponed to fund this long-delayed defense investment plan. He emphasized that defense spending cannot be a "bottomless pit."
summary.zh: 工党领袖基尔·斯塔默宣布为英国武装部队额外拨款150亿英镑，并表示一些道路和能源领域的基建项目已被搁置，以资助这项长期拖延的国防投资计划。他强调国防开支不能是一个“无底洞”。

body.en: Starmer says some capital projects on roads and energy have been shelved to fund long-delayed defence investment plan Keir Starmer is speaking now. They are at Malloy Aeronautics, a firm that designs heavy-lift drones, and Starmer says this morning they showed him one of the heaviest drones he had ever seen. Last year, I made the decision in the national interest to reprioritise aid spending towards defence and achieve the biggest uplift in defence spending since the end of the cold war. That was the right choice because the world has changed. National security is economic security. Continue reading...
body.zh: 斯塔默表示，一些道路和能源方面的资本项目已被搁置，以资助拖延已久的国防投资计划。他们在马洛伊航空公司，一家设计重型无人机的公司，斯塔默说今天早上他们向他展示了他见过的最重的无人机之一。去年，我从国家利益出发，决定重新调整国防援助支出的优先顺序，实现冷战结束以来国防支出的最大增幅。这是正确的选择，因为世界已经改变。国家安全就是经济安全。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As nations weigh the necessity of defense spending against other vital public investments, Isaiah's vision calls us to consider a future where resources are transformed. The prophet speaks of a time when swords are beaten into plowshares, reminding us that true security ultimately lies in peace and the flourishing of all.
reflection.zh: 当各国权衡国防开支与其他重要公共投资的必要性时，以赛亚的异象呼吁我们思考一个资源被转化的未来。先知谈到有一天刀剑将打成犁头，提醒我们真正的安全最终在于和平与万物的繁荣。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Anger at supreme court ruling on Trump’s power to fire agency chiefs – US politics live
title.zh: 最高法院对特朗普解雇机构负责人权力的裁决引发愤怒——美国政治直播

summary.en: The US Supreme Court is expected to deliver its final rulings for the term, including a decision on the President's authority to dismiss agency heads. This ruling has sparked anger regarding the scope of executive power. The court is also due to rule on birthright citizenship.
summary.zh: 美国最高法院预计将公布本届任期的最后裁决，其中包括一项关于总统解雇机构负责人权力的决定。这项裁决引发了对行政权力范围的愤怒。法院还将就出生公民权作出裁决。

body.en: Today is the final day for the supreme court to lay out the last rulings of its nine-month term Today, the US supreme court is due to rule on one of Trump’s core policies: the right of almost anyone born on US soil to have citizenship. The right is enshrined in the 14 th amendment to the US constitution. The amendment was passed after the US civil war to determine the citizenship of American-born people who had been enslaved. Signing a presidential executive order on the first day of his second term in office, Trump is attempting to withhold citizenship from the children of undocumented immigrants and some temporary US visitors. His administration has argued that birthright citizenship stems from a misunderstanding of the 14th amendment. Continue reading...
body.zh: 今天是最高法院公布其九个月任期最后裁决的最后一天 今天，美国最高法院将对特朗普的核心政策之一做出裁决：几乎所有在美国领土上出生的人都有权获得公民身份。这项权利被载入美国宪法第十四修正案。该修正案是在美国内战后通过的，旨在确定美国出生的被奴役者的公民身份。特朗普在第二任期的第一天签署了一项总统行政命令，试图剥夺无证移民的子女和一些临时美国游客的公民身份。他的政府辩称，出生公民权源于对第十四修正案的误解。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Supreme Court rulings often highlight the complex nature of governmental authority and its limits. Romans 13:1 reminds us that all authority is established by Yahweh, calling us to reflect on how power is exercised and interpreted within a just society. Even amidst disagreement, this truth provides a foundation for understanding the role of governing bodies.
reflection.zh: 最高法院的裁决常凸显政府权力的复杂性及其界限。罗马书13:1提醒我们，一切权柄都是雅伟所设立的，这促使我们反思在一个公正的社会中，权力应如何行使和诠释。即使存在分歧，这一真理也为理解执政机构的角色提供了基础。

verse.textEn: Let everyone be subject to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which God has established.
verse.textZh: 在上有权柄的，人人当顺服他，因为没有权柄不是出于神的。

title.en: Heavy security in South Africa as anti-migrant protesters take to the streets
title.zh: 南非反移民抗议者上街，安保严密

summary.en: Heavy security measures were in place in South Africa as anti-migrant protesters took to the streets, leading thousands of people to leave the country ahead of a deadline set by these groups.
summary.zh: 南非部署了严密安保，以应对走上街头的反移民抗议者，数千人已在这些团体设定的最后期限前离开了南非。

body.en:
Police officers have been deployed across South Africa because of fears that anti-immigration protests could turn violent as President Cyril Ramaphosa urged demonstrators to refrain from "intimidation, threats or ultimatums".

The protests mark an unofficial deadline set by campaigners for all undocumented foreigners to leave the country.

Many have already fled to escape violence and intimidation. South African police say 25,000 have been repatriated so far. Most are from other African countries.

One undocumented Malawian told the BBC he was "happy to be going back" but "heartbroken" to be leaving behind four young children.

Johannesburg, where one of the protests is taking place, is unusually quiet. Shops in the city centre are closed, while police visibility is high on major streets.

Police said that five people were arrested in Johannesburg's biggest township, Soweto, for allegedly looting a foreign-owned shop.

Five people were also arrested for allegedly breaking into a tuck shop in Hammarsdale in KwaZulu-Natal province.

Many businesses in central Durban, the main city in the province, are also shut.

Ramaphosa met some of the protest leaders on the eve of the marches in a bid to defuse tensions.

He has repeatedly warned demonstrators to act peacefully, while also accepting the need for immigration reforms.

"Some foreign nationals who live in South Africa are here lawfully," he reminded citizens in his weekly newsletter , external .

"They work, study, raise families, invest in our economy and contribute positively to our society. They too are entitled to the protection of our laws and our Constitution.

"The right to protest and freedom of expression does not allow people to threaten or intimidate others, or to engage in acts of vandalism or violence," he wrote.

There are more than three million documented foreign nationals in South Africa, according to official figures.

The statistics do not record the many more migrants believed to be in the country without papers - a bone of contention for the protesters.

A Soweto resident told the BBC that protesters merely wanted foreigners "to comply" with the laws of South Africa.

She said she had no fears of the march in Johannesburg turning violent because the heavy police presence.

Another protester, who is part of anti-migrant group Operation Dudula, said they would "push the police to do their" job if undocumented migrants did not leave South Africa.

Ahead of the deadline, thousands of migrants have been awaiting processing in temporary camps for several weeks out of fear for their safety.

In Durban, which has seen some of the biggest protests, white tents housing mostly Malawians are being dismantled as authorities race to clear the transit camp.

Yahweh's ancient command reminds us to treat the stranger residing among us as one of our own, loving them as ourselves. This principle calls us to compassion and justice, especially when fear or...
reflection.zh: 南非反移民抗议活动以及人们被迫离开的消息，凸显了社会在对待被视为外来者时常面临的紧张关系。雅伟古老的诫命提醒我们，要善待居住在我们土地上的寄居者，视他们如同本地人，爱他们如同自己。这一原则呼唤我们实践怜悯和公义，尤其当恐惧或偏见威胁要分裂社群时。

verse.textEn: When a foreigner resides among you in your land, do not mistreat them. The foreigner residing among you must be treated as your native-born. Love them as yourself, for you were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 若有外人在你们国中和你同居，就不可欺负他。和你们同居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: Chris Martin’s lost James Bond theme goes on auction with unheard Coldplay tapes
title.zh: 克里斯·马丁失传的詹姆斯·邦德主题曲与未发行的酷玩乐队录音带一同拍卖

summary.en: An acoustic demo of a song by Coldplay's Chris Martin, reportedly intended for the 1999 James Bond film "The World Is Not Enough," is being put up for auction. This lost recording is part of a larger auction that includes other formative Coldplay tapes.
summary.zh: 酷玩乐队主唱克里斯·马丁为1999年詹姆斯·邦德电影《黑日危机》创作的一首歌曲的声学小样，据报道将与其他酷玩乐队早期录音一起被拍卖。这份失传的录音是此次大型拍卖的一部分。

body.en: Acoustic recording of a song titled The World Is Not Enough included in wide-ranging auction featuring formative Coldplay recordings A lost demo recording of a song Coldplay’s Chris Martin reportedly intended for 1999 James Bond film The World Is Not Enough is going up for auction, alongside other recordings from the band’s earliest years. For the auction by Wax Poetics , the British producer Chris Allison is making available an archive of recordings the band made prior to their Allison-produced second EP The Blue Room, released in October 1999. Continue reading...

As Yahweh's handiwork, we are created with the capacity to produce works that resonate and find appreciation, even years after their initial creation. This story highlights how our creative endeavors, whether grand or seemingly small, can reflect the divine spark...
reflection.zh: 一首“失传”歌曲的发现和拍卖，提醒我们人类创造力的持久价值。作为雅伟的杰作，我们被赋予了创作作品的能力，这些作品即使在初次创作多年后，仍能引起共鸣并获得赞赏。这个故事突显了我们无论是宏大还是看似微小的创作努力，都能反映我们内在的神圣火花。

title.en: Kash Patel draws flak for posting FBI case details on social media ‘to make himself look good’
title.zh: 卡什·帕特尔因在社交媒体上发布联邦调查局案件细节“以抬高自己”而受到抨击

summary.en: Kash Patel, a former aide, is facing criticism from FBI veterans for allegedly violating legal and disciplinary rules. He is accused of prematurely sharing details of an alleged plot to attack a UFC event on social media, reportedly to enhance his own public image.
summary.zh: 前助手卡什·帕特尔因涉嫌违反法律和纪律规定而受到联邦调查局资深人士的批评。他被指控在社交媒体上过早披露了一起涉嫌袭击UFC赛事的阴谋细节，据称是为了提升个人形象。

body.en:
Kash Patel may have flouted legal constraints and the FBI’s disciplinary code in prematurely divulging arrests in an alleged plot to attack this month’s Ultimate Fighting Championship bout at the White House, bureau veterans have alleged.

The FBI director was accused of “jumping the gun” by posting details on social media of five arrests in an investigation carried out in conjunction with the Secret Service.

It subsequently emerged the inquiry was sealed by a court order, theoretically constraining Patel from publicly disclosing it. There is a general prohibition against publicising information related to sealed cases while the order remains in force, under US federal law. Although exceptions exist allowing for revealing their contents, formal court authorization would be needed to do so. Patel has previously invoked court orders sealing grand jury testimony as justification for the FBI’s inability to release many of its files on Jeffrey Epstein.

On 16 June, two days after the White House cage match, Patel revealed in an early morning tweet that five men suspected of planning to attack the event with drones and explosives had been “stopped cold”, and praised “the rapid action of the FBI, our partners, and the Department of Justice in a multi-state operation”. But the problem, according to several law enforcement officials involved in the case , was that the investigation was still ongoing and agents were still actively searching for additional suspects at the time Patel shared his post.

“While the result represented the best of investigative work, it was also nothing out of the ordinary for this law enforcement team – we are built to detect, respond to, and bring to justice those who threaten the lives of American citizens – particularly during large gatherings like the historic UFC 250 fight,” Patel wrote.

FBI insiders say the post is consistent with the director’s appetite for details of investigations that he can then publicize on social media. Lauren Anderson, who oversaw counterterrorism investigations in the US and abroad during a 29-year career at the agency, said several current and former agents who had been in meetings with Patel told her he was more focused details that he could release than on investigative developments and said they had been pressed to pass on such information.

Patel’s tendency towards premature publicity also undermined trust in the FBI from other law enforcement agencies it had to work with, she said, including the Secret Service.

The UFC post triggered an implicit rebuke from Matt Quinn, the deputy director of the Secret Service, who – without naming Patel – told journalists: “I’ll tell you a phrase I learned early in my career in the New York field office and that’s ‘Don’t choke on your own smoke.’

reflection.en: When public figures use sensitive information for self-promotion, it highlights the challenge of integrity in leadership. Proverbs 27:21 reminds us that a person's character is truly tested by the praise they receive or seek. This situation calls us to reflect on the motivations behind our actions, especially when entrusted with public trust.
reflection.zh: 当公众人物利用敏感信息进行自我宣传时，这突显了领导层诚信的挑战。箴言27:21提醒我们，一个人的品格真正受到他所获得或寻求的赞美的考验。这种情况呼吁我们反思自己行为背后的动机，尤其是在被赋予公众信任之时。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Sainsbury’s chief says grocery inflation not as bad as feared so far
title.zh: Sainsbury's首席执行官称食品杂货通胀未如预期般糟糕

summary.en: Sainsbury's CEO reported that grocery inflation has not been as severe as anticipated, with the supermarket boosting sales through price matching and favorable conditions like hot weather and World Cup matches. However, underlying economic pressures persist.
summary.zh: 英国超市Sainsbury's的首席执行官表示，到目前为止，食品杂货通胀并未像此前担心的那样糟糕。该超市通过与Aldi进行价格匹配提升了销售额，并受益于炎热天气和世界杯比赛，但系统性压力依然存在。

body.en: Supermarket has lifted sales with Aldi price match, and has benefited from hot weather and World Cup matches Business live – latest updates Grocery inflation in the UK has not been as bad as feared so far, the boss of Sainsbury’s has said, but “pressure in the system” remains as the industry hopes for a swift resolution to the Middle East conflict. Simon Roberts, the chief executive of the UK’s second-largest supermarket, said it was still early in the year and there was “still uncertainty where inflation will go”, but suggested it could come in well below the Food and Drink Federation’s initial prediction of at least 9% by December . body.zh: 超市通过阿尔迪价格匹配提升了销售额，并受益于炎热的天气和世界杯比赛商业直播——最新动态塞恩斯伯里老板表示，英国的杂货通胀到目前为止并没有像人们担心的那么严重，但“系统中的压力”仍然存在，因为该行业希望迅速解决中东冲突。英国第二大超市首席执行官西蒙·罗伯茨(Simon Roberts)表示，现在还为时尚早，“通胀走向仍存在不确定性”，但暗示通胀可能远低于食品和饮料联合会最初预测的到12月至少9%的水平。继续阅读...

Deuteronomy 8:18 encourages us to remember that it is Yahweh who gives us the ability to produce wealth, so we might not forget Him in times of prosperity or perceived ease. This perspective invites gratitude for daily sustenance and...
reflection.zh: 即使经济新闻带来喜忧参半的消息，这份报告也提醒我们供应的动态性。申命记8:18鼓励我们记住，是雅伟赐予我们获取财富的能力，这样我们才不会在繁荣或看似轻松的时期忘记祂。这种视角促使我们为日常的供应心存感恩，并承认我们福祉的最终来源，无论市场如何波动。

verse.textEn: Remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.
verse.textZh: 你要记念雅伟你的神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的。

title.en: Founder of Asian super-app Gojek sentenced to years in jail for corruption
title.zh: 亚洲超级应用Gojek创始人因腐败被判入狱数年

summary.en: Gojek founder Nadiem Makarim has been sentenced to prison for corruption related to a laptop deal made during his tenure as Indonesia's education minister.
summary.zh: Gojek创始人纳迪姆·马卡里姆因在担任印度尼西亚教育部长期间的一项笔记本电脑交易中的腐败行为被判入狱。

body.en:
The co-founder of super-app Gojek who became Indonesia's education minister has been sentenced to several years in jail for corruption.

Nadiem Makarim, 41, was found guilty of manipulating a school laptop procurement deal during his time in government to enrich himself. He had pleaded not guilty.

He received a 10-year prison sentence, but faces more jailtime as he is unable to pay restitution.

Nadiem left Gojek in 2019 to join the government of previous president Joko Widodo, and served as education minister until 2024. Critics of the Indonesian authorities say the case against him was based on little evidence and that he is the victim of a government campaign targeting political opponents.

Gojek is a popular app in South East Asia with more than 170 million people using it for transport and digital payments. Nadiem has gained a large following as the co- founder of one of Indonesia's most successful tech companies.

In addition to the 10-year prison term, Nadiem was ordered to pay restitution of 809 billion rupiah ($45m, £34m) - the amount he was found guilty of enriching himself with - or serve an additional five years.

Nadiem has said that as he is unable to pay this amount, he has effectively been sentenced to 15 years.

He also faces a one billion rupiah fine. If unpaid, he will serve an additional 190 days in jail.

The case centres on the education ministry's procurement of Chromebook laptops for schools in Indonesia from 2021 to 2022.

Prosecutors alleged that the Chromebooks were purchased even though the ministry had determined in 2018 that the computers required an internet connection to be used, which made them unsuitable in remote areas of Indonesia where internet connectivity is difficult.

The ministry went ahead with the purchase after Nadiem met with Google representatives in 2020, said prosecutors.

Prosecutors alleged that Nadiem favoured Google - a Gojek investor - when the procurement was made, saying he created tender specifications that only fit the Chrome system to "make Google the sole controller of the education ecosystem in Indonesia".

Nadiem had remained as a minority shareholder in Gojek while he was the education minister.

They said Nadiem's actions violated the government's anti-corruption pledges and harmed the education system. He was accused of causing $125m in state losses.

He was also accused of benefiting from 809 billion rupiah worth of transactions involving Gojek's holding company.

Nadiem denied that Google's investments in Gojek were connected to the procurement, and argued that the ministry's choice to purchase the Chromebooks resulted in reduced costs for the government.

He also argued that the 809 billion rupiah had always remained within company accounts and that he had never touched the money...
body.zh: 超级应用程序 Gojek 的联合创始人后来成为印度尼西亚教育部长，因腐败被判处几年监禁。 41 岁的纳迪姆·马卡里姆 (Nadiem Makarim) 因在政府任职期间操纵学校笔记本电脑采购交易以谋取私利而被判有罪。他不认罪。 他被判处 10 年监禁，但由于无法支付赔偿金，将面临更多监禁。 纳迪姆于 2019 年离开戈耶克，加入前总统佐科维多多的政府，并担任教育部长直至 2024 年。印度尼西亚当局的批评者表示，针对他的案件缺乏证据，而且他是政府针对政治对手的运动的受害者。 Gojek 是一款在东南亚很受欢迎的应用程序，有超过 1.7 亿人使用它进行交通和数字支付。作为印度尼西亚最成功的科技公司之一的联合创始人，纳迪姆赢得了大批追随者。 除了 10 年监禁外，纳迪姆还被勒令赔偿 8090 亿卢比（4500 万美元，3400 万英镑）——他因利用这笔钱致富——否则再服刑 5 年。 Nadiem 表示，由于他无法支付这笔款项，因此他实际上被判处 15 年徒刑。 他还面临 10 亿卢比的罚款。如果未支付报酬，他将再入狱 190 天。 该案件的重点是教育部在 2021 年至 2022 年期间为印度尼西亚学校采购 Chromebook 笔记本电脑。 检察官称，尽管该部在 2018 年确定这些电脑需要互联网连接才能使用，但这些 Chromebook 仍然被购买，这使得它们不适合在互联网连接困难的印尼偏远地区使用。 检察官称，纳迪姆在 2020 年与谷歌代表会面后，该部继续进行了收购。 检察官称，纳迪姆在采购时偏向 Gojek 投资者谷歌，称他制定了仅适合 Chrome 系统的招标规范，以“使谷歌成为印度尼西亚教育生态系统的唯一控制者”。 在担任教育部长期间，纳迪姆仍然是 Gojek 的少数股东。 他们表示纳迪姆的行为违反了政府的反腐败承诺，并损害了教育系统。他被指控造成 1.25 亿美元的国家损失。 他还被指控从涉及 Gojek 控股公司的价值 8090 亿卢比的交易中受益。 Nadiem 否认 Google 对 Gojek 的投资与采购有关，并认为该部选择购买 Chromebook 导致政府成本降低。 他还辩称，这8090亿卢比一直留在公司账户内，他从未动过这笔钱……

reflection.en: The sentencing of a former public official for corruption underscores the critical importance of integrity in leadership. Yahweh declares that righteous rule establishes authority, and evil acts are an abomination to those entrusted with public service. This reminds us that true governance is built on ethical conduct and accountability.
reflection.zh: 一位前公职人员因腐败被判刑，凸显了领导层诚信的至关重要性。雅伟宣告，公义的统治才能建立权柄，而邪恶的行为对受托公共服务的人来说是可憎的。这提醒我们，真正的治理是建立在道德行为和问责制之上的。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: Manhunt under way after bomb injures Ukrainian oligarch and family in Monaco
title.zh: 摩纳哥发生炸弹袭击，一名乌克兰寡头及其家人受伤，搜捕行动正在进行

summary.en: A manhunt is underway in Monaco after a bomb injured a Ukrainian oligarch and his family. The blast, described by Monaco's government head, was caused by an explosive device containing bolts and pellets.
summary.zh: 摩纳哥政府首脑表示，一枚含有螺栓和弹丸的爆炸装置导致一名乌克兰寡头及其家人受伤，目前正在进行搜捕。

body.en:
A manhunt is under way in southern France after a parcel bomb exploded at a residential building in neighbouring Monaco, severely injuring a wealthy Ukrainian businessman.

Vadym Yermolaiev, his wife and their 13-year-old son were all injured in the attack, French media report, and are being treated at a hospital in Nice. Yermolaiev and his partner are in critical condition, they say.

The blast occurred shortly before 21:00 local time (19:00 GMT) at an apartment building on Rue Révérend Père Louis Frolla, near the border with France.

Minister of State of Monaco Christophe Mirmand told French broadcaster BFM TV the suspect "appears to have left for France".

The Monaco government said a suspect was seen on a video surveillance system fleeing towards the French commune of Beausoleil on foot after the explosion, where there's now a major police effort to find him.

Video surveillance images of the moments before the attack showed a man dropping a backpack in the lobby of a building shortly before the explosion, French newspaper Le Figaro reported.

Mirmand told AFP news agency the explosive device appeared to contain bolts and pellets.

More than 100 police and emergency personnel were deployed to the scene of the blast on Monday evening.

Harri Richie, who lives around 100m away from the targeted building, told the BBC she heard an "unbelievably loud explosion" at about 21:00 local time from the underground car park she was in.

She then went up to her 11th floor apartment, where she said she saw emergency services "dragging two people out [from the building] who looked badly injured".

Emergency services arrived around five minutes after the explosion, she said, adding that there was a helicopter overhead throughout Monday night.

"This is the first time in history, to my knowledge, that such an act has taken place in the principality," Mirmand, the head of Monaco's government, said.

Monaco's Prince Albert II described the incident as a "heinous crime" and "a shock to the entire Monaco community".

He said "all concerned state services are currently being mobilised" in co-operation with the relevant French authorities.

Yermolaiev is a 58-year-old wealthy real estate developer from Dnipro, Ukraine's fourth-largest city, who has been living in Monaco.

He has big interests in the wine and alcohol business in Russian-annexed Crimea, and since 2023 has been the subject of sanctions imposed by the government in Kyiv.

He was named the 39th richest Ukrainian by Forbes magazine in 2020, with a fortune of $230m (£173.8m).
body.zh: 邻国摩纳哥一座住宅楼发生包裹炸弹爆炸，一名乌克兰富商受重伤，法国南部正在进行搜捕行动。 据法国媒体报道，瓦迪姆·耶尔莫拉耶夫、他的妻子和 13 岁的儿子在袭击中全部受伤，目前正在尼斯一家医院接受治疗。他们说，叶尔莫拉耶夫和他的搭档情况危急。 爆炸发生在当地时间 21:00（格林威治标准时间 19:00）前不久，地点为靠近法国边境的 Révérend Père Louis Frolla 街的一栋公寓楼。 摩纳哥国务大臣克里斯托夫·米尔芒 (Christophe Mirmand) 告诉法国广播公司 BFM TV，嫌疑人“似乎已前往法国”。 摩纳哥政府表示，视频监控系统显示，爆炸发生后，一名嫌疑人徒步逃往法国博索莱伊公社，目前警方正在全力寻找他。 据法国报纸《费加罗报》报道，袭击发生前的视频监控图像显示，爆炸前不久，一名男子将一个背包扔在一栋大楼的大厅里。 米尔曼德告诉法新社，爆炸装置似乎包含螺栓和弹丸。 周一晚上，100 多名警察和急救人员被部署到爆炸现场。 哈里·里奇 (Harri Richie) 住在距离目标建筑约 100m 的地方，她告诉 BBC，当地时间 21:00 左右，她从所在的地下停车场听到了“令人难以置信的巨大爆炸声”。 然后她回到了自己位于 11 楼的公寓，在那里她说她看到紧急服务人员“从大楼里拖出了两个看上去受了重伤的人”。 她说，爆炸发生后五分钟左右，紧急服务人员赶到，并补充说，整个周一晚上都有一架直升机在头顶上空停留。 摩纳哥政府首脑米尔芒表示：“据我所知，这种行为在公国历史上还是第一次。” 摩纳哥亲王阿尔贝二世形容这一事件是“令人发指的罪行”，“震惊了整个摩纳哥社会”。 他表示，“目前正在动员所有相关的国家部门”与法国有关当局合作。 叶尔莫拉耶夫是一位来自乌克兰第四大城市第聂伯罗的58岁富有的房地产开发商，一直居住在摩纳哥。 他对俄罗斯吞并的克里米亚的葡萄酒和烈酒业务有着浓厚的兴趣，自 2023 年以来一直受到基辅政府制裁。 2020 年，他被福布斯杂志评为乌克兰第 39 位富豪，拥有 2.3 亿美元（1.738 亿英镑）的财富。

reflection.en: This violent act reminds us of the destructive cycle that often follows when disputes escalate to physical harm. Yahweh's word warns that those who resort to violence often find themselves caught in its perilous grip. May we seek paths that break this cycle, rather than perpetuate it.
reflection.zh: 这种暴力行为提醒我们，当争端升级为身体伤害时，往往会陷入破坏性的循环。雅伟的话语警告说，那些诉诸暴力的人常常发现自己被其危险的掌控所困。愿我们寻求打破而非延续这一循环的道路。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: India: Congress' Ajay Rai claims 'arrest' amid Ram temple embezzlement row
title.zh: 印度：国大党领导人阿贾伊·拉伊在罗摩神庙贪污丑闻中声称“被捕”

summary.en: Uttar Pradesh Congress leader Ajay Rai claimed he was detained in Ayodhya while attempting to visit the Ram temple amidst an ongoing embezzlement controversy.
summary.zh: 印度北方邦国大党领导人阿贾伊·拉伊声称，在围绕罗摩神庙的贪污丑闻持续发酵之际，他试图参观该神庙时被拘留。

body.zh: 北方邦国大党领袖阿贾伊·拉伊 (Ajay Rai) 声称，他在阿约提亚 (Ayodhya) 被拘留，因为他在一场持续的贪污争议中试图参观拉姆神庙。 印度北方邦反对党国大党主席阿贾伊·拉伊 (Ajay Rai) 声称，周一，他在北部城市阿约提亚 (Ayodhya) 的酒店内被警方拘留，当时他正与该党代表团一起抵达 Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir，当时正值一场持续的贪污纠纷。 “人民党政府的独裁已经达到了顶峰！”拉伊在 X 上发帖称，指责总理纳伦德拉·莫迪领导的印度人民党实施了“逮捕”。 他在帖子中说：“我刚抵达阿约提亚，印度人民党政府就非常害怕，以至于警察从酒店逮捕了我，并用吉普车将我带走。” 拉伊的帖子包括一段视频，显示该地区反对派领导人坐在酒店房间的椅子上，至少两名身穿制服的警察站在旁边。 领导人质问官员为什么政府对他在寺庙祈祷有异议。官员们亲切而微笑，表示他们会确保他祈祷，但要求他理解他们的立场。 拉伊的妻子周一晚间发布了一份视频声明，表示她担心他的安全。 拉伊和一个规模更大的国大党代表团定于周二访问拉姆神庙，目前有关寺庙捐款被挪用的争议日益激烈。目前还不清楚反对派政客现在是否会参观这座寺庙。 Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir 于 2024 年 1 月由纳伦德拉·莫迪总理揭幕，是印度执政的印度教民族主义政府成功的象征。 寺庙的建设本身就存在争议，因为它是在巴布里清真寺的基础上建造的，该清真寺于 1992 年被印度教民族主义暴徒暴力拆除。建造这座宏伟的寺庙是莫迪及其部长们在 2014 年上台和 2019 年上台之前的竞选活动中的核心承诺。 该寺庙信托基金是根据内政部的通知成立的，其受托人包括总理纳伦德拉·莫迪及其政府的知名助手。 反对派领导人和批评者现在试图将莫迪政府与所谓的盗窃行为联系起来，这场争议已成为执政的印度人民党 (BJP) 政府和反对党之间的政治战场。 北方邦州官员目前正在调查腐败指控。据《印度斯坦时报》报道，周一，阿约提亚当地法院将所有涉嫌所谓捐赠诈骗的被告判处两周司法拘留。 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们的...

reflection.en: An embezzlement controversy surrounding a religious site raises questions about integrity and accountability in public life. Yahweh's word reminds us that faithfulness in small matters reflects one's character and trustworthiness in larger responsibilities. This principle calls all, especially leaders, to uphold honesty in their dealings.
reflection.zh: 围绕宗教场所的贪污丑闻引发了人们对公共生活中诚信和问责制的质疑。雅伟的话语提醒我们，在小事上的忠心反映了一个人在更大责任上的品格和可信度。这一原则呼吁所有人，特别是领导者，在他们的交往中坚持诚实。

verse.textEn: Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
verse.textZh: 人在最小的事上忠心，在大事上也忠心；在最小的事上不义，在大事上也不义。

title.en: Why are South Korean fans so angry at their football coach?
title.zh: 为什么韩国球迷对他们的足球教练如此愤怒？

summary.en: Hong Myung-bo has stepped down as South Korea's football coach following the team's failure to advance beyond the group stage in the World Cup.
summary.zh: 洪明甫在韩国队未能晋级世界杯淘汰赛阶段后辞去足球教练职务。

body.en:
Angry fans in Seoul waited for the arrival of the former head coach of South Korea's men's national football team after the country failed to advance to the World Cup knockout stages.

Announcing his resignation at a news conference in Mexico on Sunday, Hong Myung-bo said that "we didn't deliver the results that our fans expected".

The announcement came after the country's President Lee Jae Myung said that he felt "not just confusion but utter bewilderment at the unexpected outcome".

The president also called for an investigation into reasons behind the team's performance.

Seoul correspondent Jake Kwon explains how Hong went from star captain in 2002 shamed head coach in 2026.
body.zh: 在韩国未能晋级世界杯淘汰赛阶段后，愤怒的首尔球迷等待着韩国男足前主教练的到来。 洪明甫周日在墨西哥举行的新闻发布会上宣布辞职，他表示“我们没有取得球迷期望的结果”。 在此消息公布之前，韩国总统李在明表示，他“对意外的结果不仅感到困惑，而且感到完全困惑”。 总统还呼吁对球队表现背后的原因进行调查。 首尔记者 Jake Kwon 解释了 Hong 是如何从 2002 年的明星队长变成 2026 年的主教练的。

reflection.en: The intense disappointment over a team's performance highlights how much we invest in worldly achievements. While striving for excellence is commendable, this reminds us that even the most coveted "crowns" in life are ultimately perishable. Yahweh invites us to pursue a lasting prize that transcends temporary victories and defeats.
reflection.zh: 球队表现不佳引发的强烈失望，凸显了我们对世俗成就的投入。虽然追求卓越值得称赞，但这提醒我们，即使是生活中最令人向往的“冠冕”最终也是会朽坏的。雅伟邀请我们去追求那超越暂时胜利和失败的永恒奖赏。

verse.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.
verse.textZh: 凡较力争胜的，诸事都有节制，他们不过是要得能坏的冠冕；我们却是要得不能坏的冠冕。

title.en: Watch: Young bald eagle takes first flight in California
title.zh: 观看：加州幼年白头鹰首次飞行

summary.en: A popular live stream managed by the Friends of Big Bear Valley caught the moment a juvenile bald eagle nicknamed Luna spread its wings for its first flight.
summary.zh: 大熊谷之友运营的一个热门直播捕捉到了名为“露娜”的幼年白头鹰首次展翅飞翔的重要时刻。

body.en:
A young bald eagle has taken flight, leaving an empty nest in Big Bear Valley, California.

Thousands tuned in to a popular livestream set up by Friends of Big Bear Valley, to watch the juvenile eagle, nicknamed Luna, flap its wings and glide to a nearby tree for the first time.

A group of bird watchers also gathered in the California valley, east of Los Angeles, to witness the action in real time.
body.zh: 一只年轻的秃鹰起飞了，在加利福尼亚州大熊谷留下了一个空巢。 数千人收看大熊谷之友举办的热门直播，观看这只绰号为露娜的幼鹰第一次拍动翅膀滑翔到附近的一棵树上。 一群鸟类观察者也聚集在洛杉矶以东的加州山谷，实时目睹这一行动。

reflection.en: The sight of a young eagle taking its first flight reminds us of the intricate beauty and wonder of Yahweh's creation. As Job 12:7 suggests, observing the natural world can teach us profound truths about life and the Creator's design. This moment of new beginnings in nature offers a glimpse into the vast wisdom embedded in the world around us.
reflection.zh: 幼鹰首次飞翔的景象提醒我们雅伟创造的精妙之美和奇妙。正如约伯记12:7所言，观察自然界能教导我们关于生命和造物主设计的深刻真理。自然界中这新开始的时刻，让我们得以一窥周围世界蕴含的浩瀚智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: The country that's been dragged in to Australia's 'monoculture' debate
title.zh: 被卷入澳大利亚“单一文化”辩论的国家

summary.en: Pauline Hanson cited Japan as an example of a monocultural society in Australia's ongoing debate about national identity. However, experts contend that Japan's cultural reality is far more intricate than a simple monocultural model suggests.
summary.zh: 宝琳·汉森在澳大利亚关于国家认同的辩论中，将日本作为单一文化社会的典范。然而，专家们认为日本的文化现实远比单一文化模式所暗示的要复杂。

body.en:
When Pauline Hanson called for Australia to become a "monocultural" society at the National Press Club earlier this month, she reached for Japan.

But as the country became shorthand in Australia's debate over immigration and multiculturalism, experts say the comparison obscures more than it explains.

Japan, with a population around four times larger than Australia — was praised by the One Nation leader as a model of monoculturalism .

"Japan has a monoculture, so what's wrong with Australia having a monoculture?" Hanson told Seven's Sunrise program last week.

Opposition leader Angus Taylor was asked what he thought of the statement but told Channel Nine's Today show last week "I don't know what a monoculture means".

But he did make clear, "I hear ... it's something like looking like Japan. I don't want Australia to look like Japan."

On Monday Liberal backbencher Andrew Hastie sought to criticise Hanson's vision, but also dampened the idea of multiculturalism, which the prime minister gave an impassioned defence of on the same day.

"How do you police that (a monoculture)? Do we want government more involved in our lives, policing who fits into Pauline Hanson’s definition of Australian culture and who doesn’t?

"Monoculture and multicultural — they’re two extremes in a sense," Hastie told the ABC's Background Briefing programme.

Experts have cast doubt on the characterisation and pointed to the economic uplift migration has brought Japan's manufacturing industries.

Peter Chai, a research associate in political science and economics at Waseda University in Tokyo told SBS News that population data shows that Japan is not a monoculture.

"Right now, foreign labour makes up around three to four per cent of the population. So, compared to some Western countries, that level is still low, but compared to historical levels in Japan, that is actually a very high level," Chai said.

"There's been a huge increase in [immigration] in recent years and with that ... Japan is becoming more diverse in terms of its population and ethnicity".

In agriculture and farming, a monoculture can be simply defined. It's the practice of growing a single species of crop over an area of land.

When applied to sociology, the term can take on multiple meanings. It can reference limited diversity within ethnic, linguistic or religious groups and even describe norms in food and fashion.

But Professor Alan Gamlen, director of the Australian National University's Migration Hub, believes the notion of a monocultural population is a myth.

reflection.en: Debates about national identity and cultural homogeneity often overlook the shared origin of all humanity. Yahweh created every nation from a single source, intending for them to inhabit the whole earth. This truth reminds us that our common humanity transcends national or cultural distinctions, inviting us to appreciate the rich tapestry of global cultures.

title.en: 'Deliberate' explosion rocks Monaco, Ukrainian oligarch injured
title.zh: 摩纳哥发生“蓄意”爆炸，乌克兰寡头受伤

summary.en: Monaco's minister of state reported that a "deliberate" explosion, which injured a Ukrainian oligarch, was the first such incident ever recorded in the principality.
summary.zh: 摩纳哥国务大臣报告称，一起“蓄意”爆炸事件造成一名乌克兰寡头受伤，这是该公国首次发生此类事件。

body.en:
A blast from an explosive device wounded Ukrainian oligarch Vadym Yermolaiev and two others in Monaco on Tuesday, authorities said, in a "deliberate" act unprecedented in the principality.

Three people, including a teenager, were wounded in the explosion that struck around 9pm Monday local time (5am Tuesday AEST) in a residential building on a street along the border with France.

A source close to the investigation who asked not to be named told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency that one of those wounded was Yermolaiev.

Monaco's minister of state Christophe Mirmand initially told AFP the blast appeared to be "an attack", but later dropped that term, describing it as a "deliberate explosion".

Monaco's Prince Albert II described the incident as a "heinous crime" and "a shock to the entire Monegasque community".

An aide to France's interior minister Laurent Nunez said police were working "to find the perpetrator, who has fled".

An AFP photographer at the scene saw a heavy police presence with access to the area cordoned off, while a helicopter circled overhead.

Public prosecutor Stephane Thibault said a suspect had left a bag or package in the building's lobby before leaving.

Nothing appeared for the moment to indicate why the building might have been targeted, he said.

A couple in their 50s or 60s wounded in the blast were in life-threatening conditions, while a 13-year-old who was "very likely related to the couple" suffered less serious injuries, Mirmand said, without disclosing their identities.

Emergency services treated four other people for shock and cuts from windows shattered in the blast.

"This is the first time in history, to my knowledge, that such an act has taken place in the principality," he said.

Yermolaiev, a multi-millionaire Monaco resident, has been subject to sanctions from Kyiv since December 2023, which Ukrainian security services reportedly said stemmed from his alcohol business activity in Russian-occupied Crimea.

Even when confronted with such darkness, Yahweh calls us not to be overcome by it, but to seek ways to overcome evil with good. This requires a steadfast commitment to peace and justice, even amidst disruption.

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

title.en: Venezuela earthquake death toll tops 1,700 as public anger over government response grows
title.zh: 委内瑞拉地震死亡人数超1,700人，公众对政府反应的愤怒日益增长

summary.en: An earthquake in Venezuela has led to over 1,700 deaths, and public frustration is mounting due to the government's slow disaster response.
summary.zh: 委内瑞拉地震已造成逾1,700人死亡，公众对政府迟缓的救灾反应日益不满。

body.en:
The United States military raced to reopen a major port in Venezuela to ease aid deliveries on Tuesday, as deaths from last week's twin earthquakes reached more than 1,700, with tens of thousands still reported missing.

Five days after powerful back-to-back quakes flattened entire neighbourhoods of multi-story buildings in the coastal state of La Guaira, hopes of finding survivors are fading.

At a makeshift morgue set up in a port warehouse in La Guaira, hundreds of bodies were stored in white and black body bags and coffins waiting to be identified, a correspondent for the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency reported.

Dozens of relatives waited outside for news of their families as forensic personnel in blue uniforms examined the corpses.

"There were 11 people in my household; only two of us survived because we were at work," Wilker Molalla told AFP.

"My family is there — I'm told my sister and her children are there, as well as the children of my brother."

Meanwhile, US Marines were working to repair the quake-hit port to allow the delivery of supplies and equipment, a US administration official told journalists in Washington.

US Air Force personnel were already helping to restore traffic at Simón Bolívar International Airport near Caracas, which was also damaged in one of the worst quake disasters in Latin American history.

US helicopters have been ferrying in aid, and US Marines have used a landing craft to deliver supplies from the USS Fort Lauderdale, an amphibious transport dock ship docked at La Guaira.

The chances of finding anyone alive beneath metres-deep rubble have dwindled since the critical 72-hour window passed.

But a WhatsApp message ignited hopes of a miraculous find beneath the rubble, more than 120 hours after the disaster.

A woman wrote to the caretaker of a collapsed apartment building in Caraballeda, one of the worst-hit areas, about 40km from Caracas, to say she was still alive, volunteer rescuer Daniel Pino told AFP.

Also on Monday, a 21-year-old identified as Aaron Levi was rescued in the nearby town of Tanaguarena, according to a video released by a photographer who witnessed the complex operation to extract him.

Venezuelans are growing increasingly frustrated with what they see as the sluggish response of their US-backed government to the disaster.

Some 3,150 people were injured in Thursday's 7.2- and 7.5-magnitude quakes, which were also felt in neighbouring Colombia. They were Venezuela's worst earthquakes in more than a century.

title.en: Alarm over alleged abuse in French schools and nurseries
title.zh: 法国学校和幼儿园涉嫌虐待儿童事件引发警报

summary.en: Hundreds of alleged cases of physical and sexual assault against children in French nurseries and elementary schools have revealed flaws in the system, experts say. They argue that reforms are urgently needed.
summary.zh: 专家表示，法国幼儿园和小学数百起针对儿童的身体和性侵犯指控暴露了系统性缺陷，亟需改革。

body.en:
Hundreds of alleged cases of physical and sexual assault against children in French nurseries and elementary schools have revealed flaws in the system, experts say. They argue that reforms are urgently needed.

A series of alleged cases of sexual and physical assault is shining a light on fundamental problems in France 's nursery and junior school system. Politicians have promised reform — but experts say their plans don't go far enough.

Ever since April 8, 2026, Charlotte, who doesn't want her real name revealed to protect her son's identity, feels like she's cut off from her emotions.

That day, her 4-year-old son told her that a teaching assistant, called Ryan, had sexually assaulted him. At his elementary school Gustave Bienvetu in the Parisian suburb of Colombes.

"At first, I thought I had misunderstood — it seemed unimaginable that this should happen to my son. When it finally sunk in, it felt like the heavens were falling down on me," she told DW.

Charlotte and her husband alerted the school and town hall to the events. The teaching assistant was almost instantly suspended.

"According to the law, the mayor's office should have immediately alerted the prosecutor but it only did so two weeks later," she said, adding that other families at the school should have also been informed quickly.

"When this didn't happen, we pressed charges for sexual assault and told other parents about what had occurred," Charlotte said.

Two other families lodged complaints against Ryan: one for exhibitionism, as their son allegedly witnessed the scene with Charlotte's son. A second child also reported being sexually assaulted by the teaching assistant.

The town hall has refuted Charlotte's allegations. "The prosecutor was alerted after an incompressible time span needed for the drafting of a report that had to be written in a just and precise manner," the mayor's office wrote in an email to DW, adding that support was provided to the affected families.

But Anne, the co-founder of SOS Periscolaires, a collective that's taking stock of reports of physical and sexual molestation of children in nurseries and junior schools, said authorities across France are often slow to react. Her public sector job prohibits her from revealing her last name.

"It's a recurring pattern that we've seen in many of the more than 500 cases of sexual or physical violence we've registered since our foundation in 2021," she told DW.

title.en: Pride Month has great significance for those who feel invisible. In Slovenia, many LGBTQ+ people understand just what that means
title.zh: 骄傲月对那些感到被忽视的人意义重大。在斯洛文尼亚，许多LGBTQ+群体深知这意味着什么

summary.en: Slovenia's new right-wing government removed the rainbow flag from outside the Culture Ministry, an action that has drawn attention to the situation of the LGBTQ+ community in the country as Pride Month concludes.
summary.zh: 斯洛文尼亚新任右翼政府将文化部外的彩虹旗撤下，此举在骄傲月临近尾声之际，引发了人们对该国LGBTQ+群体境况的关注。

body.en:
One of the first steps taken by Slovenia's new right-wing government in June was to remove the rainbow flag outside the Culture Ministry. As Pride Month draws to a close, DW surveys the situation of the LGBTQ+ community.

Pride Month, in June, assumes greater significance if you feel invisible for the rest of the year. And many LGBTQ+ people in Slovenia understand just what that means.

There is no district — or even a single street — in the picturesque capital, Ljubljana, which could truly qualify as "gay friendly." The same goes for the country's other, smaller cities.

"In the sense of physical places that would be explicitly LGBT-friendly, there are not a lot," said Barbara Rajgelj, a lawyer who also co-runs a city center bar that stages events for gay people in Ljubljana.

Rajgelj is concerned that intolerance encouraged by political leaders is having a growing impact in her country.

"Safe spaces will be more and more important, because the violence is coming from the top down, from parliament to the digital media and to the physical spaces. And I can see that people are more and more courageous in explicitly expressing their hate," she told DW.

In previous years, Pride Month and its various events would have offered some of those safe spaces.

It has also served as an annual reminder that despite the dearth of physical infrastructure, Slovenia has a thriving LGBTQ+ community.

But this year, Pride Month has been less joyous than usual — in large part due to Slovenia's recently-installed right-wing government .

It decided that the run-up to the centerpiece Pride Parade in Ljubljana on June 13 was the perfect time to take down the rainbow flag, which had been flying outside the Culture Ministry.

As justification, an official statement insisted that the ministry "must represent all citizens and all cultural creators, regardless of their personal beliefs, identities or worldviews."

It did not elaborate on how it was representing LGBTQ+ people by removing the rainbow flag or whether appeasing homophobic views was now official policy.

Under the previous, center-left government of Robert Golob , the flag had always flown throughout Pride Month. Indeed, the outgoing government raised it at the start of June, before the new prime minister, Janez Jansa , took office a few days later.

Removing the rainbow flag was one of the first actions of his new administration. And as far as campaigners for LGBTQ+ rights in Slovenia are concerned, that sent a powerful signal.

"Even though we expected this would happen, it was still extremely symbolic, making sure that we understand — within the LGBT community and society — that things have changed," said Simona Mursec, the organizer of Ljubljana Pride .

body.zh: 斯洛文尼亚新右翼政府六月采取的首要措施之一就是拆除文化部外的彩虹旗。随着骄傲月接近尾声，德国之声对 LGBTQ+ 群体的状况进行了调查。 如果您在这一年余下的时间里感到隐形，那么六月的骄傲月就显得更加重要。斯洛文尼亚的许多 LGBTQ+ 人士都明白这意味着什么。 在风景如画的首都卢布尔雅那，没有一个地区——甚至是一条街道——可以真正成为“同性恋友好区”。该国其他较小的城市也是如此。 “就明确对 LGBT 友好的实体场所而言，并不多，”律师芭芭拉·拉杰杰 (Barbara Rajgelj) 说，她也是卢布尔雅那一家市中心酒吧的共同经营者，该酒吧为同性恋者举办活动。 Rajgelj 担心政治领导人鼓励的不宽容现象在她的国家产生越来越大的影响。 “安全空间将变得越来越重要，因为暴力是自上而下，从议会到数字媒体再到实体空间。我可以看到人们越来越勇敢地明确表达他们的仇恨，”她告诉德国之声。 在前几年，骄傲月及其各种活动会提供一些安全空间。 它还每年提醒人们，尽管斯洛文尼亚缺乏物质基础设施，但拥有蓬勃发展的 LGBTQ+ 社区。 但今年的骄傲月没有往常那么欢乐——这在很大程度上是由于斯洛文尼亚最近上台的右翼政府。 委员会决定，6 月 13 日在卢布尔雅那举行的核心骄傲游行前夕，是摘下一直飘扬在文化部外的彩虹旗的最佳时机。 作为理由，一份官方声明坚称文化部“必须代表所有公民和所有文化创造者，无论他们的个人信仰、身份或世界观如何。” 它没有详细说明如何通过移除彩虹旗来代表 LGBTQ+ 人群，也没有详细说明安抚仇视同性恋的观点是否已成为官方政策。 在前任罗伯特·戈洛布（Robert Golob）的中左翼政府领导下，这面旗帜在整个骄傲月期间一直飘扬。事实上，即将卸任的政府在六月初提出了这个问题，几天后新总理雅内兹·扬萨就职。 摘掉彩虹旗是他的新政府的首要行动之一。对于斯洛文尼亚 LGBTQ+ 权利活动人士而言，这发出了一个强有力的信号。 卢布尔雅那骄傲节的组织者西莫娜·穆塞克 (Simona Mursec) 表示：“尽管我们预计会发生这种情况，但这仍然极具象征意义，可以确保 LGBT 社区和社会内部了解情况已经发生变化。” 这些改变已经在……

title.en: Poland orders Swedish submarines to bulk up navy
title.zh: 波兰订购瑞典潜艇以增强海军实力

summary.en: Poland has ordered three Swedish submarines to enhance its naval defense capabilities. This move is part of the NATO member's broader effort to modernize its navy in response to perceived Russian aggression near its borders.
summary.zh: 波兰已订购三艘瑞典潜艇，以增强其海军防御能力。此举是这个北约成员国为应对其边境附近俄罗斯的侵略而全面实现海军现代化的一部分。

body.en:
Poland has placed an order for three Swedish submarines in an effort to step up defense capabilities. The NATO member is modernizing its navy in the face of Russian aggression at its borders.

Poland and Sweden on Monday signed a €4.2 billion ($4.8 billion) arms deal at a ceremony in the Polish seaport of Gdynia on the Baltic Sea .

In the deal, Poland 's State Treasury Armaments Agency ordered the purchase of three new submarines from Swedish aerospace and defense contractor Saab.

A Monday press release from Saab outlined the sale, saying the company would begin delivering the vessels in 2030, with the final sub delivered in 2038.  

Companies from France, Germany, Italy, South Korea and Spain submitted bids for the contract.

Poland's Prime Minister Donald Tusk, who praised defense collaboration with Sweden, announced the deal on X, posting an image of himself and his Swedish counterpart Ulf Kristersson vigorously shaking hands at the ceremony.

"A strong Polish submarine force strengthens security in our shared Baltic Sea, and across NATO as a whole. When Sweden and Poland share the most advanced capabilities in the Baltic Sea, our part of the world becomes safer," wrote Prime Minister Kristersson.

Saab, one of the largest defense manufacturers in Europe, will supply three A26, or Blekinge-class vessels, as well as a weapons package, and training and maintenance packages.

Further, Saab said that it would open maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) facilities in Poland to support the deal. These facilities, said Saab, will be operated in collaboration with Polish companies to enhance Polish defense autonomy.

Saab said the new A26-class diesel-electric subs, which can remain underwater for days, are designed to meet the demands of the Baltic Sea and that they can operate in "complete silence and remain undetected," emphasizing their stealth "intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance capabilities."

Saab CEO Micael Johansson said the vessels will strengthen the strategic partnership between NATO partner nations Sweden and Poland and that they "will play a pivotal role in enhancing security in the Baltic region."

Currently, Poland only has one submarine, an aging Russian vessel. To bridge the gap between now and 2030, Warsaw's navy will be given use of the Swedish submarine HMS Södermanland.

Europe's NATO member states have been frantically seeking to make up for lost time in bulking up their own defenses amid Russia's military aggression against Ukraine and growing doubts about US commitment to their security under President Donald Trump.

title.en: Police reveal final messages of Thai teenager before she was allegedly killed by Australian
title.zh: 警方披露泰国少女遇害前最后信息，嫌犯为澳大利亚人

summary.en: Police in Thailand have provided details regarding the murder case of a Thai teenager, for which an Australian man has been charged.
summary.zh: 泰国警方公布了一名泰国青少年被谋杀案的详细信息，一名澳大利亚男子已被控谋杀罪。

body.en:
Thai teenager Tunchanok Donhomla texted her friends that she was safe just hours before she died, the Thai police chief overseeing the case of a 46-year-old Australian man charged with murder in the country has told SBS News.

Simon Peter Carman, from the Victorian town of Ballarat, was arrested at Bangkok's main international airport on Friday evening while allegedly trying to leave the country on a Jetstar flight to Perth.

He was charged with murder after the body of Donhomla,17, was found stuffed into a black suitcase and left beside a railway line in the resort town of Pattaya, according to local media reports.

The Australian denies the charge and issued a message to the victim's family saying he "feels bad" for her death.

He also denies further charges related to taking a minor for sexual purposes and moving or concealing a body.

Thai police colonel Anek Srathongyoo, superintendent of Pattaya City Police, has described to SBS News the hours leading up to the death of the young girl nicknamed "Cake".

"According to Simon’s interrogation, Simon said he had strangled her until she was motionless, then brought her body into the bathroom. He must have been clueless to find a solution, so he stuffed her in the suitcase and left it [next to the railway track]," Srathongyoo said.

Police allege that Carman picked up the teenager near the Jomtien Beach area of Pattaya in the early hours of Thursday morning. CCTV footage shows the pair walking hand in hand at the entrance of a residential building.

Thai media and police say a violent argument broke out between the pair, allegedly over the payment of sexual services, which escalated into a fatal struggle.

Srathongyoo said the couple was "probably" arguing about their "private relationship", but that this was Carman's version of events.

When she arrived at his room, Donhomla messaged her friends via the locally popular Line messaging app that she was going to stay with Carman, Srathongyoo said.

"'I've arrived at [his] apartment. The room is so messy,'" Srathongyoo said the message read. He said it was sent so her friends knew "she had arrived so they didn't have to worry".

Carman initially denied involvement but later claimed to have acted in self-defence and alleges the teenager threatened him with a kitchen knife.

In footage taken by police, Carman expressed regret to the girl's family, while also denying he killed their loved one.

"I feel bad for what happened to your daughter. It was out of my control," he said.

title.en: Chinese tycoon Guo Wengui sentenced to 30 years in US prison for fraud
title.zh: 中国大亨郭文贵因欺诈罪在美国被判30年监禁

summary.en: Exiled Chinese tycoon Guo Wengui has been sentenced to 30 years in a US federal prison after being convicted on nine charges, including money laundering, for defrauding thousands of people.
summary.zh: 流亡海外的中国大亨郭文贵因欺诈数千人，被判犯有包括洗钱在内的九项罪名，被美国联邦法院判处30年监禁。

body.en: Guo Wengui, who gained fans for criticising China’s Communist party, was found guilty in 2024 on nine charges including money laundering A US federal court has sentenced exiled Chinese tycoon Guo Wengui to 30 years in prison, after he was convicted of defrauding thousands of people out of more than $1bn. In July 2024 , a jury unanimously found Guo, also known as Ho Wan Kwok and Miles Guo, guilty on nine of 12 charges, including securities offences, wire fraud and money laundering. The FBI arrested Guo, who is in his fifties, in March 2023 at his luxury Manhattan apartment overlooking Central Park. Continue reading...
body.zh: 因批评中国共产党而赢得粉丝的郭文贵于 2024 年被判犯有包括洗钱在内的 9 项罪名。美国联邦法院判处流亡中国大亨郭文贵 30 年监禁，此前他被判诈骗数千人超过 10 亿美元。 2024 年 7 月，陪审团一致裁定郭（又名何万郭和文贵先生）犯有 12 项罪名中的 9 项，包括证券犯罪、电汇欺诈和洗钱。 2023 年 3 月，联邦调查局 (FBI) 在郭先生位于曼哈顿、俯瞰中央公园的豪华公寓逮捕了五十多岁的郭先生。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news reminds us of the destructive power of greed, as the pursuit of wealth can lead individuals to betray trust and cause widespread harm. Yahweh's word warns that the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil, often leading to sorrow and ruin.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻提醒我们贪婪的破坏力，对财富的追求可能导致个人背弃信任并造成广泛的伤害。雅伟的话语警告说，贪财是万恶之根，常常带来悲伤和毁灭。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Chinese tycoon sentenced to 30 years in US jail
title.zh: 中国大亨在美国被判30年监禁

summary.en: A Chinese tycoon, Guo Wengui, who presented himself as a critic of China, has been sentenced to 30 years in a US prison for orchestrating fraudulent schemes that attracted numerous followers.
summary.zh: 中国大亨郭文贵自称是中国批评者，通过欺诈性计划吸引追随者，现已被判处在美国监狱服刑30年。

body.en:
Guo Wengui, who was once believed to be one of China's richest businessmen, has been sentenced to 30 years in jail in the US for running a billion dollar scam.

The former property tycoon fled China to the US in 2017, where he reinvented himself as a Communist Party critic and built a loyal online following.

But Guo was later convicted on charges of racketeering, fraud and money laundering .

New York court judge Analisa Torres said Guo had "preyed on those seeking to bring democracy to China", taking their money to fund his lavish lifestyle.

Guo - who goes by several names, including Miles Guo and Ho Wan Kwok - was sentenced in a courtroom packed with his supporters.

US attorney Sean S Buckley told the BBC: "Rather than being satisfied with the many legitimate opportunities afforded to him, Guo exploited the trust that thousands had placed in him for his own greed."

"Today's sentence shows that fame and wealth do not place you above the law, and that fraudsters who victimise families to enrich themselves will be met with significant consequences," Buckley said.

Before fleeing China, Guo built a fortune as a property developer and had good ties with the country's government.

But he sought asylum in the US after being accused by top Chinese officials of corruption.

Guo became a critic of China's Communist regime and cultivated a wide online following among the Chinese community in the US.

Prosecutors said Guo raised more than $1bn (£760m) from online followers, who joined him in investment and cryptocurrency schemes between 2018 and 2023.

The money he raised was used to fund Guo's lavish lifestyle which included a 50,000 square foot mansion, a $1m Lamborghini and a $37m yacht, they said.

Guo denied the allegations, saying the funds were used for his political activism.

He had built ties with other China critics, including Steve Bannon, a former adviser to US President Donald Trump.

Bannon and Guo often appeared in online videos and, in 2020, launched a campaign called the New Federal State of China, with the goal of overthrowing the Chinese Communist Party.

Later that year, Bannon was arrested on Guo's yacht in Connecticut. Bannon was charged in an unrelated case with fraud in an alleged scheme to defraud people who funded a not-for-profit company to build a US-Mexico border wall.

Bannon entered a guilty plea in a Manhattan court to a first degree scheme to defraud charge and received a sentence of conditional discharge for three years.

He also faced federal charges over the wall campaign after he was indicted by a federal grand jury, but the prosecution came to a halt after Trump pardoned him in the final hours of his first White House term .
body.zh: 曾被认为是中国最富有的商人之一的郭文贵因诈骗10亿美元而在美国被判处30年监禁。 这位前房地产大亨于 2017 年逃离中国前往美国，在那里他将自己重塑为一名共产党批评者，并在网上建立了一批忠实的追随者。 但郭后来因敲诈勒索、欺诈和洗钱罪被定罪。 纽约法院法官阿娜丽莎·托雷斯 (Analisa Torres) 表示，郭文贵“掠夺了那些寻求为中国带来民主的人”，拿走他们的钱来资助他奢华的生活方式。 郭文贵有多个名字，包括郭文贵和何云国，他在法庭上被判刑，法庭上挤满了他的支持者。 美国律师肖恩·S·巴克利 (Sean S Buckley) 告诉英国广播公司 (BBC)：“郭并没有满足于为他提供的许多合法机会，而是利用了数千人对他的信任来满足自己的贪婪。” 巴克利说：“今天的判决表明，名誉和财富并不能让你凌驾于法律之上，那些为了自己中饱私囊而伤害家庭的诈骗犯将面临严重后果。” 在逃离中国之前，郭作为房地产开发商积累了巨额财富，并与中国政府关系良好。 但在被中国高级官员指控腐败后，他在美国寻求庇护。 郭成为中国共产党政权的批评者，并在美国华人社区中培养了广泛的网络追随者。 检察官称，郭从在线追随者那里筹集了超过 10 亿美元（7.6 亿英镑），这些追随者在 2018 年至 2023 年间与他一起参与了投资和加密货币计划。 他们说，他筹集的资金用于资助郭的奢华生活方式，其中包括一座 50,000 平方英尺的豪宅、一辆价值 100 万美元的兰博基尼和一艘价值 3700 万美元的游艇。 郭否认这些指控，称这些资金用于他的政治活动。 他与其他中国批评者建立了联系，其中包括美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的前顾问史蒂夫·班农。 班农和郭文贵经常出现在网络视频中，并在2020年发起了一场名为“新中国联邦”的运动，目标是推翻中国共产党。 同年晚些时候，班农在郭文贵在康涅狄格州的游艇上被捕。班农在另一起不相关的案件中被指控犯有欺诈罪，涉嫌诈骗资助一家非营利公司修建美墨边境墙的人。 班农在曼哈顿一家法院对一级诈骗指控认罪，并被判处有条件释放三年。 在被联邦大陪审团起诉后，他还因筑墙运动而面临联邦指控，但在特朗普在第一个白宫任期的最后几个小时赦免他后，起诉停止了。

reflection.en: This story reminds us that Yahweh values integrity and truthfulness in all dealings, especially in financial matters. While the pursuit of wealth can be tempting, true prosperity is built on honesty and ethical conduct, which delights Yahweh.
reflection.zh: 这个故事提醒我们，雅伟在一切交易中都看重正直和诚实，尤其是在财务方面。虽然追求财富可能充满诱惑，但真正的昌盛是建立在正直和道德行为之上的，这令雅伟喜悦。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: EU sets up three months of talks with China over €360bn trade deficit
title.zh: 欧盟就3600亿欧元贸易逆差与中国展开为期三个月的谈判

summary.en: The European Union and China have agreed to three months of talks to address a significant €360bn trade deficit, aiming to create a more balanced bilateral relationship and avert a potential trade war after weeks of rising tensions.
summary.zh: 欧盟与中国已同意进行为期三个月的谈判，以解决高达3600亿欧元的贸易逆差问题，旨在建立更平衡的双边关系，并在数周的紧张局势后避免潜在的贸易战。

body.en: Two sides agree to try to make bilateral relationship ‘more balanced’ after weeks of threats The EU and China have agreed to enter three months of talks to try to avoid a trade war over the bloc’s €360bn (£310bn) annual import/export imbalance. In their first joint statement in seven years, the two sides agreed in Brussels to open a formal trade consultation after weeks of threats and recriminations from China if the EU imposed any measures to stop the flood of goods and components into the bloc. Continue reading...
body.zh: 经过数周的威胁，双方同意努力使双边关系“更加平衡” 欧盟和中国同意进行为期三个月的谈判，以避免因欧盟每年 3600 亿欧元（3100 亿英镑）的进出口失衡而爆发贸易战。在七年来的首份联合声明中，双方同意在布鲁塞尔举行正式贸易磋商，此前中国连续数周发出威胁和指责，如果欧盟采取任何措施阻止商品和零部件大量涌入欧盟，两国将启动正式贸易磋商。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In a world often quick to escalate disputes, the agreement between the EU and China to engage in talks to resolve trade imbalances offers a hopeful example of pursuing peace. Yahweh's word encourages us to live at peace with everyone, as far as it depends on us, seeking common ground even amidst significant disagreements. This diplomatic effort reflects a...
reflection.zh: 在一个常常迅速升级争端的世界里，欧盟与中国同意通过谈判解决贸易不平衡问题，提供了一个追求和平的充满希望的范例。雅伟的话语鼓励我们，只要我们能做到，就尽力与所有人和平相处，即使在重大分歧中也要寻求共同点。这种外交努力体现了对话而非冲突的承诺，通过耐心的谈判争取建立平衡的关系。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Weather tracker: Heatwave expected to bring Germany and Poland to 40C
title.zh: 天气追踪：德国和波兰预计将迎来40摄氏度高温热浪

summary.en: An intense heatwave is expected to bring temperatures up to 40C in parts of central and northern Europe, including Germany and Poland. The Austrian Grand Prix has declared a heat hazard due to the dramatic rise in temperatures.
summary.zh: 预计一股强烈的热浪将使中欧和北欧部分地区（包括德国和波兰）的气温升至40摄氏度。由于气温急剧上升，奥地利大奖赛已宣布高温危险。

body.en: Austrian Grand Prix declares heat hazard as dramatic rise in temperatures forecast in central and northern Europe Temperatures are forecast to rise dramatically in parts of central and northern Europe this weekend as the intense heatwave continues . In Germany and Poland, highs up to or exceeding 40C (104F) are expected on both Saturday and Sunday, days after swathes of France experienced similar extreme temperatures. The Austrian Grand Prix, taking place this weekend in Spielberg, has declared a heat hazard , the first race to do so this season. Temperatures are expected to rise into the low 30s celsius during the race, almost 10C warmer than usual for the venue. Across Europe, the intense heat has led to severe thunderstorms. In the Sverdlovsk region of central Russia, a strong tornado was reported on the evening of 22 June. Rated a 3 out of 5 on the international Fujita scale, the twister injured 16 people and destroyed or damaged about 100 homes and businesses in the town of Kushva. Emergency services have been working on restoring power to the town. Tornadoes are not unheard of in Russia but are rare. Forecasters say they may become more common in future as the climate breaks down. Storm warnings remained in effect in the southern part of the country on Friday. Continue reading...
body.zh: 预计中欧和北欧气温将急剧上升，奥地利大奖赛宣布存在热危险 随着强烈热浪的持续，预计本周末中欧和北欧部分地区气温将大幅上升。在德国和波兰，预计周六和周日气温将达到或超过 40 摄氏度（104 华氏度），几天前法国大片地区也经历了类似的极端气温。本周末在斯皮尔伯格举行的奥地利大奖赛已宣布出现高温危险，这是本赛季第一场这样做的比赛。预计比赛期间气温将升至 30 摄氏度，比平时高出近 10 摄氏度。在整个欧洲，酷热导致了严重的雷暴天气。 6月22日晚，俄罗斯中部斯维尔德洛夫斯克地区报告出现强烈龙卷风。国际藤田等级评定为 3 级（满分 5 级），龙卷风造成 16 人受伤，并摧毁或损坏了库什瓦镇约 100 所房屋和企业。紧急服务部门一直致力于恢复该镇的供电。龙卷风在俄罗斯并非闻所未闻，但很罕见。预报员表示，随着气候的恶化，它们未来可能会变得更加普遍。周五，该国南部地区的风暴警告仍然有效。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic rise in temperatures across Europe reminds us that creation itself is experiencing distress. As the natural world groans under changing conditions, we are called to reflect on our interconnectedness with the earth and its well-being. This intense heatwave serves as a poignant reminder of the broader challenges facing our shared home.
reflection.zh: 欧洲气温的急剧上升提醒我们，受造界本身正在经历痛苦。当自然界在不断变化的环境下发出呻吟时，我们被呼召反思我们与地球及其福祉的相互关联。这场强烈热浪是对我们共同家园所面临的更广泛挑战的深刻提醒。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Xi Jinping has hosted more than a dozen leaders this year, as ‘middle powers’ look beyond the US
title.zh: 习近平今年接待了十几位领导人，‘中间力量’超越美国寻求合作

summary.en: China's leader, Xi Jinping, has hosted numerous world leaders this year, aiming to promote an alternative global order. This effort is reportedly aided by the perceived unpredictability of the United States, prompting 'middle powers' to explore new international alignments.
summary.zh: 中国领导人习近平今年接待了多位世界各国领导人，旨在推动一种替代性的全球秩序。据报道，美国的反复无常助长了这一努力，促使“中等强国”寻求新的国际结盟。

body.en: China’s leader wants to promote his alternative to the current world order, and his efforts are being assisted by a capricious US Xi Jinping meets Bangladesh’s new prime minister on Friday, the latest in a wave of world leaders to visit Beijing this year as the Chinese leader builds his influence and economic ties, and seeks to “shift the balance of power” away from the west. Xi’s meeting with Tarique Rahman comes less than two weeks after the Chinese leader welcomed Myanmar’s military chief-turned-president, Min Aung Hlaing, in Beijing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国领导人希望推行他对当前世界秩序的替代方案，他的努力得到了反复无常的美国的协助。习近平周五会见了孟加拉国新总理，这是今年访问北京的一波世界领导人中最新的一位，中国领导人正在建立影响力和经济联系，并寻求“改变力量平衡”，远离西方。习近平与塔里克·拉赫曼的会面是在中国领导人在北京欢迎缅甸军方最高领导人、现任总统敏昂莱之后不到两周。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news highlights how nations are drawn to leaders who articulate a clear vision for the future, especially when existing global structures seem uncertain. Proverbs 29:18 reminds us that without a guiding vision, people and nations can lose their way. This underscores the profound impact of leadership that offers a coherent path forward.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻强调，当现有的全球秩序显得不确定时，各国会被那些为未来描绘清晰愿景的领导人所吸引。箴言29:18提醒我们，没有指引的异象，人民和国家就会迷失方向。这突显了提供连贯前进道路的领导力所产生的深远影响。

verse.textEn: Where there is no revelation, people cast off restraint; but blessed is the one who heeds wisdom's instruction.
verse.textZh: 没有异象，民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便为有福。

title.en: UK to halve tariff-free steel imports to counter glut of cheap Chinese metal
title.zh: 英国将削减免关税钢材进口量以应对廉价中国金属过剩

summary.en: The UK government announced it will halve the amount of tariff-free steel imports, doubling duties on quantities exceeding the new quota. This measure, mirrored by similar changes in EU limits, aims to counter a global oversupply of cheap Chinese metal and support domestic industry.
summary.zh: 英国政府宣布将把免关税钢材进口量减半，超出新配额的进口将加倍征收关税。此举与欧盟的类似调整相呼应，旨在应对全球廉价中国金属的过剩供应，并扶持本国产业。

body.en: Duty on imports outside new quota will double in move echoing similar changes in EU limits Business live – latest updates The UK government will halve the amount of tariff-free steel imports allowed in an attempt to counter a global oversupply of cheap Chinese metal and bolster its beleaguered local industry. New “safeguards” will be introduced on 1 July and will coincide with similar new limits being introduced by the EU for the same purposes. The UK said it and the EU had agreed an approach that reflected each other’s “highly interconnected supply chains” after months of negotiations over retaining tariff-free access between the markets. Continue reading...
body.zh: 新配额之外的进口关税将翻倍，与欧盟限制的类似变化相呼应英国政府将允许的免关税钢铁进口量减半，以应对全球廉价中国金属供应过剩的问题，并提振陷入困境的当地工业。新的“保障措施”将于 7 月 1 日推出，并将与欧盟出于相同目的推出的类似新限制同时实施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Nations often grapple with balancing economic interests and ensuring fair trade practices. Proverbs 11:1 reminds us that Yahweh values honest dealings and just measures in commerce. This principle encourages leaders to seek equitable solutions that promote integrity in global markets.
reflection.zh: 国家常在经济利益与确保公平贸易实践之间寻求平衡。箴言11:1提醒我们，雅伟看重商业中的诚实交易和公正的度量。这一原则鼓励领导者寻求公平的解决方案，以促进全球市场的诚信。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: What is China’s SpaceSail, and could it rival Elon Musk’s Starlink?
title.zh: 中国的“太空帆”是什么？它能与埃隆·马斯克的星链竞争吗？

summary.en: China's state-backed SpaceSail project is developing a satellite internet constellation to compete with Elon Musk's Starlink. With hundreds of satellites in low Earth orbit, the company is reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries.
summary.zh: 中国国家支持的“太空帆”项目正在开发一个卫星互联网星座，旨在与埃隆·马斯克的星链竞争。该公司目前在近地轨道拥有数百颗卫星，据报道正在与数十个国家进行谈判。

body.en: The company has just a few hundred satellites in low Earth orbit but has state backing and is already reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries Elon Musk’s Starlink has long dominated the satellite internet industry, but a Chinese government-backed project is aiming to challenge its position. SpaceSail has just a few hundred satellites in low Earth orbit compared with Starlink’s 10,000-plus. But the company says it now has enough satellites to begin its first commercial application, is scaling up at speed, and is reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries to provide satellite internet coverage. Continue reading...
body.zh: 该公司在近地轨道上只有几百颗卫星，但有国家支持，据报道已经与数十个国家进行谈判。埃隆·马斯克的星链长期以来一直主导着卫星互联网行业，但一个中国政府支持的项目旨在挑战其地位。与 Starlink 的 10,000 多颗卫星相比，SpaceSail 在近地轨道上只有几百颗卫星。但该公司表示，它现在拥有足够的卫星来开始其首次商业应用，并且正在快速扩大规模，据报道正在与数十个国家进行谈判以提供卫星互联网覆盖。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As nations and companies embark on ambitious technological ventures like SpaceSail, it reminds us of the human drive to innovate and connect the world. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our plans to Yahweh, trusting that our efforts, when aligned with His purposes, will find success. This perspective can guide us in all our endeavors, from grand...
reflection.zh: 当各国和公司着手像“太空帆”这样雄心勃勃的技术项目时，这提醒我们人类创新和连接世界的动力。箴言16:3鼓励我们将我们的计划交托给雅伟，相信我们的努力，若与祂的旨意相符，必将成功。这种视角可以指导我们所有的努力，无论是宏伟的项目还是日常任务。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Dear You review – enjoyable Chinese romdram crosses generations as it tracks down a missing husband
title.zh: 《亲爱的你》影评：一部跨越世代、追寻失踪丈夫的感人华语爱情剧情片

summary.en: The Guardian China reviews "Dear You," a Chinese romantic drama by director Lan Hongchun. The film is a multi-generational family saga, spanning from the 1940s to the present, primarily set in Bangkok, and follows the search for a husband who disappeared in Thailand.
summary.zh: 《卫报中国》评论了导演蓝鸿春的华语爱情剧情片《亲爱的你》。这部电影是一部跨越几代人的家族传奇，故事从20世纪40年代至今，主要背景设在曼谷，讲述了一个家庭寻找在泰国失踪的丈夫的故事。

body.en: Director Lan Hongchun’s family saga feels like a good old-fashioned novel as it goes in search of a man who has disappeared in Thailand With a story that ranges from the 1940s to the present and, although mostly set in Bangkok, revolving largely around Teochew-speaking Chinese from Guangdong, this generations-spanning drama feels like a good old-fashioned novel. A romantic beach read, perhaps, the kind in which coincidences and random accidents cause misunderstandings that last for decades until the truth is finally revealed. It’s sentimental in places, sure, but there’s also a fair bit of salty, bawdy humour to cut the sweetness, lashings of period colour, and impressively naturalistic performances from a mostly non-professional cast. All that has helped to make this an unexpectedly large box-office hit in the People’s Republic last month; and for non-Chinese or Thai rom-dram aficionados anywhere, it’s well worth looking out for. As the story opens in the 21st century in the Chinese city of Shantou, octogenarian Shurou (Iap Sok-jiu) is celebrating her 87th birthday, surrounded by adoring friends, family and neighbours who revere the matriarch, not least for managing to raise three kids on her own in the 1940s and 50s. Her shifty grandson Xiaowei (Hiau-ui), however, is less of a solid citizen and, having got into debt, he decides to travel to Bangkok to find out if Shurou’s husband Zheng Musheng, not seen for decades, could help out since he’s reputed to have made a fortune out there, endowed schools all over Thailand, and had a second family after abandoning Shurou. Continue reading...
body.zh: 导演兰鸿春的家庭传奇感觉就像一部优秀的老式小说，讲述了在泰国寻找失踪男子的故事。故事范围从 20 世纪 40 年代至今，虽然主要以曼谷为背景，但主要围绕来自广东的潮州华人展开，这部跨越几代人的戏剧感觉就像一部优秀的老式小说。浪漫的海滩读物，也许是那种巧合和偶然的事故会导致持续数十年的误会，直到真相最终揭晓的类型。当然，它在某些地方是感伤的，但也有一些咸味、下流的幽默来削弱甜蜜，充满时代色彩，以及来自大多数非专业演员的令人印象深刻的自然主义表演。所有这些都使得该片上个月在中华人民共和国取得了意想不到的票房大成功。对于任何地方的非中国或泰国的浪漫剧爱好者来说，这都非常值得一看。故事发生在 21 世纪的中国汕头市，八十多岁的淑柔（叶淑如饰）正在庆祝她的 87 岁生日，周围都是崇拜这位女族长的朋友、家人和邻居，尤其是她在 20 世纪 40 年代和 50 年代设法独自抚养三个孩子。然而，她狡猾的孙子小伟（孝仪饰）却不是一个踏实的公民，负债累累，他决定前往曼谷，看看书柔数十年未见的丈夫郑木胜是否可以帮忙，因为他在外面发了大财，为泰国各地的学校捐款，并在抛弃书柔后有了第二个家庭。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The multi-generational search for a missing husband in "Dear You" powerfully illustrates the enduring nature of family bonds. This long quest reflects the deep commitment inherent in marriage, where two become one, a union that transcends time and distance. It reminds us that true connection often calls for steadfastness, even in the face of profound...
reflection.zh: 电影《亲爱的你》中跨越几代人寻找失踪丈夫的故事，有力地展现了家庭纽带的持久性。这场漫长的寻觅反映了婚姻中固有的深刻承诺，夫妻二人成为一体，这种结合超越了时间和距离。它提醒我们，真正的连接往往需要坚韧不拔，即使面对巨大的不确定性也是如此。

verse.textEn: That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is united to his wife, and they become one flesh.
verse.textZh: 因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。

title.en: Dettol apologises after ‘toxic men’ advert sparks backlash in China
title.zh: 滴露因“有毒男性”广告在中国引发反弹后致歉

summary.en: British hygiene brand Dettol has apologized and withdrawn an advertisement in China that sparked widespread condemnation. The advert, which the company stated was intended to criticize “toxic men,” featured a man seeking a “clean and untouched” woman.
summary.zh: 英国卫生品牌滴露在中国发布的一则广告引发广泛谴责后，已致歉并撤回该广告。滴露公司称该广告旨在批评“有毒男性”，但其内容却描绘了一名男子寻找“干净纯洁”女性的情节。

body.en: British disinfectant brand withdraws advert about a man’s efforts to find a ‘clean and untouched’ woman The British hygiene brand Dettol has apologised after an advertisement released in China, which it said was intended to criticise “toxic men”, was widely condemned on social media as offensive to women. The five-minute advert for a multipurpose disinfectant, released across many online platforms at the end of May, features a man comparing his girlfriend with his former partner. Learning that his former girlfriend previously lived with someone else, the man likens their relationship to a “secondhand service”. He then tells his friends that he intends to find a “clean and untouched” woman for whom he can be the first sexual partner. Continue reading...
body.zh: 英国消毒剂品牌撤回有关男性努力寻找“干净、未受影响”女性的广告英国卫生品牌滴露在中国发布的一则广告道歉，称该广告旨在批评“有毒男性”，该广告在社交媒体上受到广泛谴责，认为该广告冒犯了女性。五月底，多用途消毒剂的五分钟广告在多个在线平台上发布，其中一名男子将他的女朋友与他的前伴侣进行了比较。当得知他的前女友以前与别人住在一起时，该男子将他们的关系比作“二手服务”。然后他告诉他的朋友，他打算找一个“干净、未受污染”的女人作为他的第一个性伴侣。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The controversy surrounding Dettol's advertisement highlights the importance of recognizing the inherent dignity of every individual. When an advert reduces women to an object defined by their perceived “purity” or “untouched” status, it diminishes the profound truth that all people, male and female, are created in the image of Yahweh. This reminds us to...
reflection.zh: 滴露广告引发的争议，凸显了承认每个人固有尊严的重要性。当一个广告将女性贬低为由其所谓的“纯洁”或“未被触碰”状态来定义的客体时，它就削弱了一个深刻的真理：所有的人，无论男女，都是按雅伟的形象被造的。这提醒我们要维护他人的价值，反映出神赋予每个生命的尊贵。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy publisher Jimmy Lai honored by DW
title.zh: 香港亲民主派出版商黎智英获德国之声表彰

summary.en: Jimmy Lai, a Hong Kong pro-democracy publisher, has been honored by DW. He founded Hong Kong's largest pro-democracy newspaper before being sentenced to 20 years in prison. His son stated that the award signifies that those who advocate for the freedom of others are not alone.
summary.zh: 香港亲民主派出版商黎智英获得德国之声表彰。他在被判处20年监禁前，创办了香港最大的亲民主报纸。他的儿子表示，这个奖项表明那些为他人自由而奋斗的人“从不孤单”。

body.en:
Before being imprisoned for 20 years, Jimmy Lai founded Hong Kong's largest pro-democracy newspaper. His son said the award shows that those who fight for the freedom of others "are never alone."

Arriving in Hong Kong as a penniless 12-year-old stowaway from southern China, Jimmy Lai sought only freedom and a future. At the time, Lai could never have imagined how his life would become forever intertwined with this former British colony.

"I'll sink with the ship, because this place gives me everything," said Lai in an interview about Hong Kong with DW a few months before he was taken into custody in December 2020. He was one of the first high-profile figures to be targeted under a "national security law" imposed on Hong Kong by Beijing following a crackdown on pro-democracy protests.

Beijing had said the law would restore Hong Kong "from chaos to order" after demonstrations in 2019 opposing an extradition bill morphed into massive protests against Beijing encroaching on Hong Kong's civil liberties .

Since then, the pro-democracy media mogul has spent more than 2,000 days in solitary confinement in Hong Kong's maximum-security Stanley Prison.

Lai's years-long trial ended this February, when the 78-year-old was sentenced to 20 years in prison for "colluding with foreign forces." While he had pleaded not guilty to all charges, his legal team said he will not appeal.

The sentence is the heaviest punishment handed down so far under the national security law, and Lai's trial has symbolized for many people the severe erosion of press freedom in Hong Kong as part of Beijing's broader strategy to silence critical voices.

In recognition of his defense of press freedom and freedom of speech, DW honored Jimmy Lai with this year's Freedom of Speech Award  at the annual Global Media Forum in Bonn, Germany, on Tuesday.

"While we have spoken freely in the defence of independent media, Jimmy, who founded an independent media company because he believed in the rights of the Hong Kong people to receive information, is locked away for those beliefs," Jodie Ginsberg, CEO of the Committee to Protect Journalists, said in a speech honoring Lai.

"The attacks on Apple Daily and its counterparts in Hong Kong presaged the far greater attacks on civil liberties in the years that followed. Jimmy Lai saw this and spoke out. We can honor him today not only by fighting for his freedom, but by defending the freedoms for which he was jailed."

Since 2015, the DW Freedom of Speech Award has honored journalists and human rights defenders as a way to call attention to restrictions on press freedom and concerning human rights situations around the world.

body.zh: 在入狱20年之前，黎智英创办了香港最大的民主报纸。他的儿子表示，该奖项表明那些为他人自由而奋斗的人“永远不会孤单”。 黎智英 (Jimmy Lai) 12 岁，身无分文，从中国南方偷渡到香港，他只寻求自由和未来。当时，黎智英无法想象他的生活将如何与这个前英国殖民地永远交织在一起。 黎智英在 2020 年 12 月被拘留前几个月接受德国之声采访时表示，“我将与船一起沉没，因为这个地方给了我一切。”黎智英是北京在镇压亲民主抗议活动后对香港实施的“国家安全法”中首批成为目标的知名人士之一。 在2019年反对引渡法案的示威演变成针对北京侵犯香港公民自由的大规模抗议活动后，北京曾表示，该法律将使香港“从混乱中恢复秩序”。 此后，这位亲民主媒体大亨在香港戒备森严的赤柱监狱中被单独监禁了 2000 多天。 黎智英长达数年的审判于今年 2 月结束，78 岁的他因“勾结外国势力”被判处 20 年徒刑。虽然他对所有指控均表示不认罪，但他的法律团队表示他不会上诉。 这一判决是迄今为止根据国家安全法作出的最重处罚，对许多人来说，黎智英的审判象征着香港新闻自由的严重侵蚀，而这是北京压制批评声音的更广泛战略的一部分。 为了表彰黎智英对新闻自由和言论自由的捍卫，周二在德国波恩举行的年度全球媒体论坛上，德国之声授予黎智英今年的言论自由奖。 保护记者委员会首席执行官朱迪·金斯伯格(Jodie Ginsberg)在向黎智英致敬的演讲中表示：“虽然我们畅所欲言地捍卫独立媒体，但吉米因为相信香港人民有权接收信息而创立了一家独立媒体公司，但他却因为这些信念而被关起来。” “对《苹果日报》及其香港同行的攻击预示着随后几年对公民自由的更大攻击。黎智英看到了这一点并大声疾呼。今天我们不仅可以通过为他的自由而奋斗，而且可以通过捍卫他被监禁的自由来向他致敬。” 自 2015 年以来，德国之声言论自由奖一直向记者和人权捍卫者授予荣誉，以此呼吁人们关注世界各地对新闻自由的限制和人权状况。 黎智英的儿子塞巴斯蒂安·赖（Sebastien Lai）是黎智英释放的长期倡导者，他在四月份告诉德国之声，“那些反抗的人......

reflection.en: Jimmy Lai's recognition, even amidst his imprisonment, highlights the enduring cost of standing for truth and freedom. Yahweh's word reminds us that those who face persecution for righteousness are truly blessed, finding a profound solidarity that transcends their circumstances. This spiritual truth offers hope that their sacrifices are seen and honored,...
reflection.zh: 黎智英在狱中获得表彰，凸显了为真理和自由挺身而出的持久代价。雅伟的话语提醒我们，那些因行义而受逼迫的人是有福的，他们会找到一种超越境况的深刻团结。这个属灵真理带来希望，他们的牺牲是被看见和尊重的，即便人间的公义有时会失落。

verse.textEn: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
