title.en: Labor’s gambling ad legislation a ‘capitulation’ to industry lobby, Liberal MP says
title.zh: 工党赌博广告立法被自由党议员称为向行业游说团体“屈服”

summary.en: Opposition parties and crossbenchers have criticized the government's proposed reforms to gambling advertising, calling them insufficient and a "capitulation" to industry lobbyists. They argue the measures are too weak to effectively address the issue.
summary.zh: 反对党和独立议员批评政府提出的赌博广告改革措施，称其力度不足，是对行业游说团体的“屈服”。他们认为这些措施过于软弱，无法有效解决问题。

body.en: Coalition, Greens and crossbenchers all say the planned reforms are too weak and the proposals are ‘half-arsed’ Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Labor’s reforms to gambling advertising have been branded a “capitulation” and “half-arsed” by opponents, as the Liberals and Greens combine to urge the government to go further in cracking down on wagering. Three years this week since the Murphy report recommended a full ad ban, Labor’s proposed wagering reforms have underwhelmed the parliament, with the Coalition, Greens and crossbenchers all saying the changes are too weak – making it unclear whether the government’s bill will have enough support to pass into law. Continue reading...
body.zh: 联盟党、绿党和中立议员都表示，计划中的改革太软弱，提案“半途而废”。 工党对赌博广告的改革被反对者称为“投降”和“半途而废”，而自由党和绿党联手敦促政府进一步打击博彩。自墨菲报告建议全面禁止广告以来的本周，工党提出的投注改革方案并未给议会留下深刻的印象，联盟党、绿党和中立议员都表示这些改革力度太弱，这使得政府的法案是否能获得足够的支持以通过成为法律尚不清楚。继续阅读...

reflection.en: When leaders are perceived to yield to powerful interests rather than protect the vulnerable, it raises questions about their commitment to justice. Yahweh calls those in authority to actively do what is right, ensuring the oppressed are delivered and no wrong is done to the weak. This story reminds us of the constant need for leaders to prioritize the...
reflection.zh: 当领导者被认为屈服于强大势力而非保护弱势群体时，这引发了对其对正义承诺的质疑。雅伟呼召掌权者积极行义，确保受压迫者得到解救，弱者不受侵害。这个故事提醒我们，领导者需要始终将所有公民的福祉置于特殊利益之上。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Georgie Purcell facing antisemitic and misogynistic abuse due to having Jewish partner, commission hears
title.zh: 乔治·珀塞尔因其犹太伴侣而面临反犹太和厌女辱骂，委员会听证会获悉

summary.en: A royal commission investigating antisemitism and social cohesion in Australia has heard evidence that politician Georgie Purcell has been subjected to antisemitic and misogynistic abuse online due to her Jewish partner. The commission is examining the prevalence of hateful speech in digital environments.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚一项调查反犹太主义和社会凝聚力的皇家委员会听取了证据，指出政治家乔治·珀塞尔因其犹太伴侣而在网上遭受了反犹太和厌女的辱骂。该委员会正在审查数字环境中仇恨言论的普遍性。

body.en: The royal commission into antisemitism and social cohesion is hearing evidence about hateful speech in the online environment Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Vile, threatening abuse is being levelled at witnesses to the antisemitism royal commission, the inquiry has heard, while a Labor MP has said attacks on his partner were heightened because they were stacked with misogyny. Meanwhile, data analysis has shown how quickly factual reports are transformed into conspiracy theories online, and that while there was a spike in antisemitism after the Bondi terror attack, there was a “huge spike” in anti-Muslim hate. Continue reading...
body.zh: 反犹太主义和社会凝聚力皇家委员会正在听取关于网络环境中仇恨言论的证据，调查获悉，反犹太主义皇家委员会的证人正在受到威胁性虐待，而一名工党议员表示，针对他伴侣的攻击加剧了，因为这些言论充满了厌女症。与此同时，数据分析显示，事实报道在网上转变为阴谋论的速度有多快，虽然邦迪恐怖袭击后反犹太主义激增，但反穆斯林仇恨也“大幅飙升”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The online abuse faced by Georgie Purcell highlights how words, when wielded with malice, can inflict deep wounds. Yahweh's wisdom reminds us that while reckless words can pierce like swords, wise and gracious speech offers healing and builds up rather than tears down. May we seek to use our words to uplift and unite, especially in public discourse.
reflection.zh: 乔治·珀塞尔所面临的网络辱骂，凸显了言语在恶意驱使下能够造成多深的伤害。雅伟的智慧提醒我们，鲁莽的言语如刀剑刺人，而智慧和恩慈的言语则带来医治，是建造而非拆毁。愿我们在公共言论中，努力用言语去提升和团结他人。

verse.textEn: The words of the reckless pierce like swords, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.
verse.textZh: 说话浮躁的，如刀刺人；智慧人的舌头却为医人的良药。

title.en: Thai police investigate if Australian man charged over 17-year-old girl’s murder linked to other unsolved cases
title.zh: 泰国警方调查澳籍男子被控谋杀17岁少女案是否与其他未侦破案件有关联

summary.en: Thai police are investigating an Australian man charged with the murder of a 17-year-old girl, Thunchanok Donhomla. Authorities are examining potential links between this case and two other unsolved deaths in the same region over the past two years, noting similarities but no definitive evidence yet.
summary.zh: 泰国警方正在调查一名被控谋杀17岁女孩Thunchanok Donhomla的澳大利亚男子。当局正在审查此案与过去两年在该地区发生的另外两起未侦破死亡案件之间是否存在潜在联系，警方指出存在相似之处，但尚未有确凿证据。

body.en: Police say there are similarities but no evidence of links between Thunchanok Donhomla’s alleged murder and two other deaths in past two years in same region Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Thai police are investigating whether an Australian man charged with murdering a 17-year-old girl could be linked to two unsolved cases in the region. Police colonel Anek Srathongyoo, a superintendent of Pattaya City police station, told the Guardian on Tuesday that although there was no evidence linking Simon Peter Carman to the cases in neighbouring regions, they were investigating the possibility given similarities between the cases. Continue reading...
body.zh: 警方表示，Thunchanok Donhomla 涉嫌谋杀案与过去两年同一地区的另外两起死亡事件之间存在相似之处，但没有证据表明存在联系。 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 泰国警方正在调查一名被指控谋杀一名 17 岁女孩的澳大利亚男子是否与该地区两起未侦破的案件有关。芭堤雅市警察局局长阿内克·斯拉通尤 (Anek Srathongyoo) 上校周二告诉《卫报》，虽然没有证据表明西蒙·彼得·卡曼与邻近地区的案件有关，但鉴于两起案件有相似之处，他们正在调查这种可能性。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The tragic death of a young person reminds us of the profound vulnerability of the innocent and the deep pain caused by such acts. Yahweh's word warns of severe consequences for those who cause harm to the young, underscoring our collective responsibility to protect them.
reflection.zh: 一位年轻生命的悲惨逝去，提醒我们无辜者的脆弱，以及此类行为所造成的深切痛苦。雅伟的话语严厉警告那些伤害孩童的人将面临的后果，强调了我们保护他们的集体责任。

verse.textEn: If anyone causes one of these little ones — those who believe in me — to stumble, it would be better for them to have a large millstone hung around their neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.
verse.textZh: 凡使这信我的一个小子跌倒的，倒不如把大磨石拴在这人的颈项上，沉在深海里。
verse.themeEn: Woe to those who harm children

title.en: NSW’s deadly one-in-100-years floods could have been slashed by two metres using dams, CSIRO finds
title.zh: 联邦科学与工业研究组织发现，新南威尔士州百年一遇的致命洪水本可通过水坝削减两米

summary.en: A CSIRO report found that building 10 new dams in New South Wales's northern rivers could have reduced flood levels by two meters during Lismore's 2022 floods, which killed 13 people. Governments have not yet committed to these recommended measures.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚联邦科学与工业研究组织（CSIRO）的一份报告发现，在新南威尔士州北部河流建造10座新水坝，本可以使利斯莫尔2022年洪水的水平降低两米，那次洪水导致13人死亡。政府尚未承诺采取报告中建议的措施。

body.en: Governments have not committed to measures modelled in the report on Lismore’s 2022 floods, which led to the deaths of 13 people Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Building 10 new dams in New South Wales’s northern rivers could have reduced flood levels by up to two metres during devastating floods in 2022, but not enough to prevent a key levee overspilling, a report has found. The CSIRO report was released on Tuesday, four years after it was commissioned by the Morrison government following NSW’s one-in-100-years floods. Continue reading...
body.zh: 各国政府尚未承诺采取报告中针对利斯莫尔 2022 年洪水的措施，该洪水导致 13 人死亡 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 一份报告发现，在新南威尔士州北部河流修建 10 座新水坝，可以在 2022 年毁灭性洪水期间将洪水水位降低最多两米，但不足以防止关键堤坝溢出。联邦科学与工业研究组织 (CSIRO) 的报告于周二发布，距莫里森政府在新南威尔士州发生一百年一遇的洪水后委托编写该报告已有四年。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The report on Lismore's devastating floods highlights the critical role of wise counsel in governance. When expert advice on preventative measures is available, the failure to act can lead to tragic consequences and loss of life. Yahweh's word reminds us that safety and success often depend on heeding sound guidance.
reflection.zh: 关于利斯莫尔毁灭性洪水的报告，凸显了明智建议在治理中的关键作用。当有关于预防措施的专家建议时，未能采取行动可能导致悲剧性后果和生命损失。雅伟的话语提醒我们，安全和成功往往取决于听从健全的指导。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Garth Hamilton storms out of question time after outburst – as it happened
title.zh: 澳大利亚政治直播：加思·汉密尔顿在质询时间情绪失控后离场；查尔默斯称反对党正经历“崩溃”而非营销问题

summary.en: An Australian politician, Garth Hamilton, reportedly stormed out of question time after an outburst, prompting Treasurer Chalmers to describe the opposition's behavior as a "meltdown." This occurred amidst government scrutiny over cooling house market forecasts and falling auction clearance rates.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚政治家加思·汉密尔顿据报道在质询时间因情绪失控而离场，财政部长查尔默斯将反对党的行为描述为“崩溃”。此事发生在政府因澳大利亚房地产市场降温预测和拍卖清盘率下降而面临审查之际。

body.en: This blog is now closed Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Chalmers defends house price forecasts The government has been facing some heat over the cooling house market around Australia with falling auction clearance rates, and forecasts that house prices in Sydney and Melbourne could fall more than $100,000. Auction clearance rates in Brisbane came up on the weekend, if you compare the preliminary numbers from the week before. They also came up in Adelaide. They came up nationally in aggregate, as I understand it. But in Sydney and Melbourne, we saw some softness there, that actually predated the budget announcements. It doesn’t make a lot of sense to replace one big distortion that Howard and Costello introduced when they made that big policy mistake in 1999 and ruined the housing market for too many people, especially young people; [it] doesn’t make sense to replace that big distortion with another big distortion. And so we’re applying this CGT discount – there’s still a discount, just calculated differently to reflect real gains – we’re applying it fairly and neutrally across the board so that we don’t introduce another big distortion and repeat the mistakes. Some people think that we’re stuck in the past and our policies need to resonate with the Australia of today and the future. So I think it’d be a really good time for us to revisit our values. If things aren’t resonating, and if people are actually latching on to our policies and believing in that, but they’re not wanting to vote for us, then maybe we need to do something about the brand, I want us to have more cut-through on our policies. I worked for John Howard back in the day, and my patch, we were the Howard battlers, we’re the Menzies Forgotten people, and we’re Tony Tradie. So we are pretty much the heartland of Australia. And when the heartland of Australia tells you that you need to get more cut-through to get more voters on your side, then you need to listen to the people. Continue reading...
body.zh: 关注今日新闻直播 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 查默斯为房价预测辩护 政府一直面临着澳大利亚各地房屋市场降温、拍卖清盘率下降的压力，并预测悉尼和墨尔本的房价可能下跌超过 10 万澳元。如果你比较前一周的初步数据，布里斯班的拍卖清盘率在周末出现了上升。他们也出现在阿德莱德。据我了解，他们在全国范围内总体上出现了。但在悉尼和墨尔本，我们看到了一些疲软的情况，这实际上早于预算公布之前。取代霍华德和科斯特洛在 1999 年犯下的重大政策错误并毁掉了太多人（尤其是年轻人）的房地产市场时引入的一项重大扭曲没有多大意义；用另一种大扭曲来代替那种大扭曲是没有意义的。因此，我们正在应用这个资本利得税折扣——仍然有折扣，只是以不同的方式计算以反映实际收益——我们正在全面公平、中立地应用它，这样我们就不会引入另一个大的扭曲并重复错误。有些人认为我们陷入了过去，我们的政策需要与澳大利亚的今天和未来产生共鸣。所以我认为现在是我们重新审视我们的价值观的好时机。如果事情没有引起共鸣，如果人们确实关注我们的政策并相信这一点，但他们不想投票给我们，那么也许我们需要对品牌做一些事情，我希望我们在政策上有更多的切入点。我当时为约翰·霍华德工作，在我的补丁中，我们是霍华德的斗士，我们是被遗忘的孟席斯人，我们是托尼·特拉迪。所以我们几乎是澳大利亚的中心地带。当澳大利亚的中心地带告诉你，你需要获得更多的支持才能获得更多选民支持时，你就需要倾听人民的声音。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the heat of political debate, words can easily escalate tensions, as seen in the recent parliamentary outburst. Yahweh's wisdom reminds us that a gentle answer has the power to de-escalate conflict, while harsh words only fuel anger and division. May leaders and citizens alike seek to engage with grace and respect, even amidst strong disagreements.
reflection.zh: 在激烈的政治辩论中，言语很容易加剧紧张局势，正如最近议会中的情绪失控所见。雅伟的智慧提醒我们，温柔的回答有能力化解冲突，而严厉的言语只会煽动愤怒和分裂。愿领袖和公民都能在强烈分歧中，以恩典和尊重进行交流。

verse.textEn: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
verse.textZh: 回答柔和，使怒消退；言语暴戾，触动怒气。

title.en: Could this be Australia’s warmest winter ever?
title.zh: 这会是澳大利亚有史以来最暖的冬天吗？

summary.en: Australia is experiencing an unusually warm winter, leading to concerns that it could be the warmest on record. This unseasonable weather is impacting the start of the ski season, making conditions unsuitable for hitting the slopes.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚正经历一个异常温暖的冬季，引发了人们对其可能成为有记录以来最暖冬季的担忧。这种不合时宜的天气正在影响滑雪季的开始，使得滑雪条件不佳。

body.en:
Many parts of Australia have already broken early winter maximum and minimum temperature records.

In southern Australia, Sydney and Melbourne had their warmest-ever starts to winter. Daily observations show both cities experienced above-average June temperatures almost every day of the month.

Adelaide has also recorded above-average June temperatures in its first three weeks. Hobart and Canberra had mild starts to winter, with temperatures well above normal. So far, Perth is the only southern capital with typical June temperatures.

The world is experiencing a trend of unseasonably high temperatures driven by global heating, including the early summer heatwave in western Europe and parts of Asia.

So, what can we expect for the rest of the winter season? And does a warm winter have consequences for Australia’s next summer?

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Abnormally warm conditions in Australia are likely to continue for at least the coming weeks, according to the Bureau of Meteorology’s seasonal outlooks . Long periods of dry weather are likely, especially in late winter and spring, following the recent El Niño development .

However, infrequent cold polar outbreaks still can impact southern Australia due to jet stream "waviness" south of Australia. Here, waviness is the meandering of the air currents as they form the jet stream. If this occurs in a north-south direction instead of west to east, this can affect the movement of cold air and low pressure systems.

A poor 2026 Australian ski season has just started, and the outlook for sufficiently deep snow cover is unfavourable. However, just one or two unexpected heavy snowstorms can produce a major season turnaround.

The seasons underway in Australia exemplify a worldwide trend of unseasonably high temperatures, including the early summer heatwave in western Europe .

Previously, extreme summer temperatures occurred later in the European summer, during July or August. But the present heatwave has produced record June maximum temperatures throughout Europe.

On 26 June, the United Kingdom’s hottest ever June day, temperatures reached 37.3C. The previous all-time UK June record was 36.1C in 1976. During the heatwave, much of France, Spain, Italy and Germany reached or exceeded 40C. Humidity levels have also been high. This unusually early and intense heatwave confirms climate extremes are the new normal.

Many nations are facing their warmest winters on record. The extreme heat is due to accelerated global warming since the 1990s, caused by human-made climate change. The United Nations predicts hot and cold extremes in nearly all inhabited regions with increasing global...
body.zh: 澳大利亚许多地区已经打破了初冬最高和最低气温记录。 在澳大利亚南部，悉尼和墨尔本迎来了有史以来最温暖的冬季。每日观测显示，这两个城市几乎每个月的每一天都经历了高于平均水平的气温。 阿德莱德在前三周的六月气温也高于平均水平。霍巴特和堪培拉入冬初期气候温和，气温远高于正常水平。到目前为止，珀斯是唯一拥有典型六月气温的南方首府。 世界正在经历由全球变暖驱动的反常高温趋势，包括西欧和亚洲部分地区的初夏热浪。 那么，我们对冬季剩下的时间可以期待什么呢？温暖的冬天会对澳大利亚明年的夏天产生影响吗？ 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 根据气象局的季节性展望，澳大利亚异常温暖的天气可能至少在未来几周内持续。随着最近厄尔尼诺现象的发展，可能会出现长期干旱天气，特别是在冬末和春季。 然而，由于澳大利亚南部的急流“波状”，罕见的寒冷极地爆发仍然会影响澳大利亚南部。在这里，波纹度是气流形成喷射流时的蜿蜒曲折。如果这种情况发生在南北方向而不是从西向东，则会影响冷空气和低压系统的运动。 2026 年澳大利亚滑雪季刚刚开始，雪况不佳，积雪深度不够的前景不容乐观。然而，只要一两次意外的暴风雪就可以带来重大的季节转变。 澳大利亚正在经历的季节体现了全球反常高温的趋势，包括西欧的初夏热浪。 此前，极端夏季气温发生在欧洲夏季晚些时候，即七月或八月。但目前的热浪已经在整个欧洲创造了六月份创纪录的最高气温。 6月26日，英国六月以来最热的一天，气温达到37.3摄氏度。英国6月最高气温纪录是1976年的36.1摄氏度。在热浪期间，法国、西班牙、意大利和德国的大部分地区达到或超过40摄氏度。湿度也很高。这场异常早且强烈的热浪证实极端气候已成为新常态。 许多国家正面临有记录以来最暖的冬天。极端高温是由于20世纪90年代以来人为气候变化导致的全球变暖加速造成的。联合国预测，随着全球变暖的加剧，几乎所有有人居住的地区都会出现极端炎热和寒冷的天气。

reflection.en: The news of an unusually warm winter affecting the ski season reminds us of the subtle shifts occurring in our natural world. Romans 8:22 speaks of creation groaning, a poignant image that resonates when natural rhythms seem disrupted. It invites us to consider our role in caring for the earth Yahweh has entrusted to us.
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚冬季异常温暖，影响滑雪季的消息，提醒我们自然界正在发生的微妙变化。罗马书8:22提到受造之物一同叹息，这幅画面在自然节律被打乱时尤为深刻。它邀请我们思考在看顾雅伟所托付的地球上的责任。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: EY sacks graduate employee after he allegedly accessed Australian PM’s bank account
title.zh: 据称，安永解雇了一名毕业生员工，原因是他涉嫌侵入澳大利亚总理的银行账户

summary.en: Two men – including one who worked for EY – appear in court after being charged over accessing restricted data Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast An employee at one of Australia’s big four accounting firms has been sacked after he and another man...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Two men – including one who worked for EY – appear in court after being charged over accessing restricted data Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast An employee at one of Australia’s big four accounting firms has been sacked after he and another man allegedly accessed the prime minister Anthony Albanese’s personal banking account. The men, aged 21 and 25, faced court on Tuesday over the breach, which Australian federal police alleged occurred when the EY graduate was on secondment at the Commonwealth Bank. Continue reading...
body.zh: 两名男子（其中一名是安永员工）因访问受限数据而被指控出庭。 澳大利亚四大会计师事务所之一的一名员工被解雇，因为他和另一名男子涉嫌访问总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞的个人银行账户。周二，这两名年龄分别为 21 岁和 25 岁的男子因违规行为而受审。澳大利亚联邦警方称，这名安永毕业生在联邦银行借调期间发生了违规行为。继续阅读...

reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到公义、尊严与问责。Micah 6:8提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以带着怜悯的公义来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Only a royal commission can get to the bottom of mounting claims of misconduct on Victoria’s Big Build | Deborah Glass
title.zh: 黛博拉·格拉斯：只有皇家委员会才能查清维多利亚州“大型建设项目”日益增多的不当行为指控

title.en: The country that's been dragged in to Australia's 'monoculture' debate
title.zh: 被卷入澳大利亚“单一文化”辩论的国家

summary.en: Pauline Hanson has cited Japan as an example of monoculturalism in Australia's ongoing debate about national identity and cultural diversity. However, experts contend that Japan's cultural reality is far more intricate than a simple monocultural label suggests.
summary.zh: 宝琳·汉森在澳大利亚关于国家认同和文化多样性的持续辩论中，将日本视为单一文化的典范。然而，专家们认为，日本的文化现实远比简单的单一文化标签所暗示的要复杂得多。

body.en:
When Pauline Hanson called for Australia to become a "monocultural" society at the National Press Club earlier this month, she reached for Japan.

But as the country became shorthand in Australia's debate over immigration and multiculturalism, experts say the comparison obscures more than it explains.

Japan, with a population around four times larger than Australia — was praised by the One Nation leader as a model of monoculturalism .

"Japan has a monoculture, so what's wrong with Australia having a monoculture?" Hanson told Seven's Sunrise program last week.

Opposition leader Angus Taylor was asked what he thought of the statement but told Channel Nine's Today show last week "I don't know what a monoculture means".

But he did make clear, "I hear ... it's something like looking like Japan. I don't want Australia to look like Japan."

On Monday Liberal backbencher Andrew Hastie sought to criticise Hanson's vision, but also dampened the idea of multiculturalism, which the prime minister gave an impassioned defence of on the same day.

"How do you police that (a monoculture)? Do we want government more involved in our lives, policing who fits into Pauline Hanson’s definition of Australian culture and who doesn’t?

"Monoculture and multicultural — they’re two extremes in a sense," Hastie told the ABC's Background Briefing programme.

Experts have cast doubt on the characterisation and pointed to the economic uplift migration has brought Japan's manufacturing industries.

Peter Chai, a research associate in political science and economics at Waseda University in Tokyo told SBS News that population data shows that Japan is not a monoculture.

"Right now, foreign labour makes up around three to four per cent of the population. So, compared to some Western countries, that level is still low, but compared to historical levels in Japan, that is actually a very high level," Chai said.

"There's been a huge increase in [immigration] in recent years and with that ... Japan is becoming more diverse in terms of its population and ethnicity".

In agriculture and farming, a monoculture can be simply defined. It's the practice of growing a single species of crop over an area of land.

When applied to sociology, the term can take on multiple meanings. It can reference limited diversity within ethnic, linguistic or religious groups and even describe norms in food and fashion.

But Professor Alan Gamlen, director of the Australian National University's Migration Hub, believes the notion of a monocultural population is a myth.

title.en: Australia has signed a long-awaited Vanuatu security deal. Here's what's in it
title.zh: 澳大利亚签署期待已久的瓦努阿图安全协议。内容是什么？

summary.en: Australia and Vanuatu have finalized a security deal after ten months of negotiations. The agreement, described as lucrative, is expected to have significant implications for the Pacific region.

body.en:
After months of negotiations, Australia and Vanuatu have signed a watered-down $500 million security deal.

The Nakamal Agreement was signed by Prime Minister Anthony Albanese and Vanuatu Prime Minister Jotham Napat in Canberra on Monday.

The deal was inked almost 10 months after Napat pulled out of a signing ceremony due to concerns that Vanuatu's sovereignty would be undermined.

Albanese said the agreement "reflects and confirms" Australia's role as Vanuatu's "largest and most comprehensive economic security and development partner, a responsibility that we take seriously".

"This agreement advances a consensus that security is the shared responsibility of the Pacific family ... and encapsulates Vanuatu's sovereign decision not to permit its territory to be used for any foreign military base or infrastructure."

"With the signing of the long-awaited Nakamal Agreement, Australia and Vanuatu are close neighbours, trusted partners," he said.

The Nakamal Agreement cements Australia as the Pacific island nation's primary aid and policing partner.

It's a bid to steer the nation away from China, which is currently pursuing a deal with Vanuatu, known as the Namele Agreement.

It's a refurbished version of the 2025 agreement, which gave Australia the power to veto Chinese involvement in Vanuatu's critical infrastructure, including ports, telecommunications, digital, aviation, and energy.

That agreement, which was set to be finalised in September 2025, was abandoned by Vanuatu after members of the government raised concerns for the nation's sovereignty.

Australia originally pledged $500 million across ten years to support Vanuatu's government. Now, that money will be spread across a longer, unspecified period.

The agreement requires the Nakamal committee to convene at least every six months to address and resolve any issues or disputes between the two nations.

The agreement requires Vanuatu to consult Australia on "proposed third-party engagement in Vanuatu's critical infrastructure".

Any critical infrastructure must also remain free from "militarisation, any form of foreign interference or unauthorised access".

It also requires Vanuatu to prioritise the Pacific Forum, an alliance of 18 Pacific nations, for policing requests.

In the event of a humanitarian disaster, Vanuatu will first request foreign aid from FRANZ — a humanitarian coalition comprising France, Australia and New Zealand.

Australia and Vanuatu will collaborate on cyber infrastructure and renewable energy transition and Australia will support shortfalls in Vanuatu's workforce.

title.en: The $54 million sponsorships raising questions about influence over Aussie kids

summary.en: Six children's programs in Australia received $54 million in sponsorships from resource companies, with hundreds of additional deals. This has led to calls for scrutiny regarding the extent of corporate influence on children's content.

body.en:
Across 31 lifesaving clubs in Western Australia, thousands of children learn beach safety and surf skills in their iconic singlets and caps. Since 2019, those uniforms have been emblazoned with the name of the country's largest independent oil and gas company: Woodside.

This sponsorship, worth approximately $5 million, is just one of around 260 programs designed for Australian children sponsored by fossil fuel companies, according to a new report.

The report, published on Monday by climate communication charity, Comms Declare, found fossil fuel money was behind a broad range of programs aimed at children in schools, museums, and sporting clubs across the country.

"This report lays bare just how much effort is going into [fossil fuel companies'] buying a social licence," independent senator David Pocock told the media on Monday.

"[It lays bare] how much effort is going into shaping what young Australians think and understand about fossil fuel companies' contribution to a changing climate."

Woodside pointed SBS News to its 2025 Social Contribution Report, which said its social investments raised awareness and understanding of the environment; supported early childhood development and education; and created resilient and sustainable communities.

Pocock, along with senators Penny Allman-Payne and Steph Hodgins-May, have called on the government to launch a Senate inquiry into the influence of fossil fuel companies over children's public life.

The report named Santos as the biggest sponsor of children's programs with 71 programs, as well as BHP, Woodside, Glencore, Chevron, and Shell.

While Western Australia had the highest concentration of sponsorships, with 120 programs, researchers found the programs clustered in remote areas where the mining industry had a stronger presence.

In some instances, oil and gas companies were sponsoring the production of climate education materials in ways that minimised the role of burning fossil fuels as the main driver of global warming .

Last year, the Queensland Museum retired materials from Shell's sponsored "Future Makers" learning program, after Comms Declare found its explanation of carbon dioxide absorption in the oceans failed to mention where excess carbon dioxide comes from .

Another activity asked students to design technological responses to carbon reduction, such as carbon capture and storage, which critics argue shifts responsibility from reducing emissions .

The materials, designed for students in grades 7-10, had been downloaded 400,000 times, according to reporting by The Guardian.

title.zh: 部分家庭可从周三起获得免费电力。您符合条件吗？

summary.en: A new scheme in Australia will provide eligible households with three hours of free electricity daily, regardless of whether they have rooftop solar panels.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚一项新计划将为符合条件的家庭每天提供三小时免费电力，无论他们是否安装了屋顶太阳能。

body.en:
Some Australians in the country's east will soon be able to receive free electricity for three hours per day, as part of the federal government's Solar Sharer Offer.

Starting Wednesday, the scheme is designed to give more households access to solar power when it's most abundant during the day, the scheme will be available to renters and homeowners living in NSW, South Australia and south-east Queensland, all of which are covered by the Default Market Offer (DMO).

Set by the Australian Energy Regulator, the DMO is the maximum price that energy retailers can charge residential and small business customers on a standing offer electricity contract. Other states and territories have their own systems.

Households don't need to have their own rooftop solar to be eligible, but they do need to live in one of the three areas and have a household smart meter installed. They also have to use a retailer that is required to offer the Solar Sharer Offer — any in the DMO areas with more than 1,000 customers — and not be supplied through an embedded network.

Eligible households will be able to access up to 24kWh of free electricity during a three-hour window each day. For NSW and south-east Queensland, the window is from 11am to 2pm AEST. In South Australia, the window will be from 12pm to 3pm ACST.

The offer isn't automatic. Eligible households will need to opt in through their energy retailer.

Back in January, Energy Minister Chris Bowen said the Solar Sharer Offer was about "making sure we make the most of our huge solar generation".

"It will provide direct bill savings for households who sign up and can move their energy use into the zero-cost power period, while also taking pressure off evening peak demand, lowering network and system security costs," he said.

On its website, Australia's energy department says households eligible for the Solar Sharer Offer can take advantage of it by planning around the three-hour daily window.

It suggests running larger appliances during the free-power period "where it is safe and practical to do so". That may include heating and cooling, using clothes dryers, washing machines, dishwashers and EV chargers.

It also suggests planning to complete regular household tasks, such as laundry or dishwashing, during the period.

In Victoria, where the DMO doesn’t apply, the state government has announced that it will roll out the Midday Energy Saver from October.

The scheme will offer a free power window between 11am and 2pm every day. Victorians interested in accessing the scheme will need to contact their own retailers to sign up by 1 October.

reflection.en: This new scheme offering free electricity to some households reflects a societal effort to ease burdens and provide for basic needs. Yahweh reminds us that acts of kindness towards those in need are seen as lending to Him, promising a divine reward for such generosity. It's a reminder that caring for the vulnerable is a principle valued by Yahweh.
reflection.zh: 这项为部分家庭提供免费电力的新计划，体现了社会减轻负担、满足基本需求的努力。雅伟提醒我们，对有需要的人施以援手，如同借贷给祂，祂必会为此慷慨之举赐予回报。这提醒我们，关怀弱势群体是雅伟所珍视的原则。

verse.textEn: Whoever is kind to the poor lends to Yahweh, and he will reward them for what they have done.
verse.textZh: 怜悯贫穷的，就是借给雅伟；他的善行，雅伟必偿还。

title.en: Paul Hogan hits back at 'pelican' Hanson over 'monoculture' claim
title.zh: 保罗·霍根回击“鹈鹕”汉森的“单一文化”主张

summary.en: The One Nation leader's approval ratings dropped after her National Press Club speech.
summary.zh: “一国党”领导人在国家新闻俱乐部发表演讲后，其支持率有所下降。

body.en:
Australian acting legend Paul Hogan has rejected Pauline Hanson's "monoculture" comments , accusing the One Nation leader of "living in the past" in an interview with the Australian Financial Review.

"She's a pelican, yeah. Outrageous, so racist. It sounds very much like this stupid boofhead over here, Trump," Hogan told the Australian Financial Review on Sunday.

The 86-year-old actor is best known for playing leather-clad larrikin Mick Dundee in the Crocodile Dundee movies, which have shaped an enduring image of Australians in United States popular culture.

His comments came after Hanson's speech at the National Press Club , where she called for the end of multiculturalism, in favour of "monoculturalism".

"We are a multiracial society, but we must be monocultural. Australians must live under the one cultural umbrella," she said.

When later asked to clarify what she meant by "monoculture", Hanson told the Senate last week: "Bring back Paul Hogan and Norman Gunston. These are the essential features of Australian monoculture, and there's nothing remotely exclusionary about them."

"We're all migrants, except the Aboriginals, who as far as we know have been [in Australia] for 60,000 years."

Most Australians — 75 per cent — agree that multiculturalism is good for society, according to Australian Bureau of Statistics polling released in May this year.

However, that sentiment has decreased by 10 per cent since 2020, with similar declines in Australians' overall trust in institutions and life satisfaction.

Hogan, who lives in California, praised his home country's diverse roots and said that he couldn't wait to return to Australia.

A pair of polls, conducted since Hanson's expansive speech at the National Press Club, have indicated a post-Press Club headache for One Nation and its leader.

Labor has reclaimed a narrow lead in both the Newspoll and RedBridge surveys, released on Sunday night.

Newspoll, printed in The Australian, has Labor on 33 per cent (up three), with One Nation on 29 (down two) and the Greens on 14 (up two).

The RedBridge poll had Labor on 30 per cent support (up two) compared to One Nation's 29 (down two), with the Coalition on just 18 (down two) and the Greens on 14 (up two).

They have even worse news for the Coalition, with the Newspoll putting Opposition support at a historic low of 17 per cent.

The RedBridge poll, reported in the Australian Financial Review, also had Hanson's net approval falling 10 points from a neutral position to (-10).
